On three held-out benchmarks, RECAST improves over the strongest baseline by 15.0% on average, demonstrating strong zero-shot generalization across tasks and heterogeneous source representations.

</details>


### [329] [SciExam for ENSO: Can AI Agents Build Climate Models?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10513)
*Yinling Zhang,Langchen Liu,Dongbin Xiu,Xueyan Zou,Xu Kuang,Mengdi Wang,Shilong Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SciExam for ENSO基准，让AI代理在6小时内从真实观测构建ENSO低阶随机模型，由隐藏评分器检验统计重现、隐变量恢复与预测能力。12个代理中6个超越已发表模型，且其简化模型形式与ENSO冷暖不对称的两大争议解释各自相容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对语言模型代理科研能力的评估通常依赖已知答案、评分标准或语言模型评审，无法判断一个全新科学模型是否有效。需要一个在"答案未知"情境下评估代理研究能力的基准。

Method: 以ENSO（年际气候变率主导模态）为任务：代理在6小时预算内处理真实观测，自行编写诊断工具（随后冻结），仅凭这些诊断反馈开发低阶随机模型。隐藏评分器测试模型是否复现ENSO统计特征、恢复未观测变量、预测留出年份，并以同样方式给一个已发表模型打分；另做信息变量控制实验。

Result: 12个代理系统中6个得分高于已发表模型，主要优势在重建与预测。较强模型的简化形式分别与ENSO冷暖不对称的两大竞争解释之一相容（该争论任务中从未提及）。控制实验表明高分并非来自记忆旧观测记录，且所接收信息会影响建模方式。

Conclusion: SciExam for ENSO证明可在无已知答案时评估代理科研；结果表明代理已能构建具竞争力的模型，且其结构触及科学家仍在争论的问题。

Abstract: Language-model agents are increasingly asked to carry out open-ended scientific research, yet their results are usually graded against a known answer, a rubric, or a language-model reviewer, none of which can tell whether a new scientific model is valid. The AI Science Exam for El Nino-Southern Oscillation (SciExam for ENSO) is a benchmark in which agents build low-order stochastic models of ENSO, the dominant mode of interannual climate variability, from real observations. Within a six-hour budget, agents process the observations, write their own diagnostics, which are then frozen, and develop a model using only these diagnostics as feedback. Hidden graders then test whether the model reproduces ENSO's statistics, recovers unobserved variables, and forecasts held-out years, and score a published model in the same way. Across twelve agent systems, six produce models that score higher than the published model, mainly through better reconstruction and forecasting. The simplified forms of the stronger models are each compatible with one of the two competing explanations of ENSO's warm-cold asymmetry, an open debate that the task never mentions. Controlled runs of the top system under varied information suggest that its scores do not come from recalling the dated observational record and that the information it receives shapes how it builds its model. SciExam for ENSO can thus evaluate agent research where no answer is known, and the results suggest that agents can already build competitive models whose structures bear on questions that scientists still debate.

</details>


### [330] [RoboJEPA: Scaling Robotic Latent World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10515)
*Artem Zholus,Nicolas Beltran-Velez,Jianhao Yuan,Sarath Chandar,Tushar Nagarajan,Daniel Severo,Koustuv Sinha,Michal Drozdzal,Adriana Romero Soriano,Jeannette Bohg,Nicolas Ballas,Mahmoud Assran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出RoboJEPA，一个基于JEPA架构、在12种机器人实体的大规模数据集上训练的隐世界模型，首次建立了多实体机器人世界模型的扩展规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐世界模型在预测未来状态和规划方面表现出色，但目前缺乏一种有原则的方法来估计其能力如何随模型规模、数据和计算量扩展，这一问题阻碍了领域进展。

Method: 提出RoboJEPA，基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），在涵盖12种机器人实体的大规模数据集上训练，参数量达8B，为迄今最大的JEPA预测器模型。

Result: RoboJEPA的想象误差（隐rollout误差）随计算量遵循二阶幂律，可外推预测远超拟合规模的模型质量；下游规划性能随计算量可预测地提升，且想象误差与其强相关，可作为真实机器人评估的可靠代理；模型可零样本部署为机器人智能体，朝单一目标图像规划完成长时程任务。

Conclusion: 这是首个为基于真实机器人数据的多实体世界模型建立扩展规律的工作，验证了想象误差作为评估代理的有效性，并开源了所有检查点及训练和部署代码。

Abstract: Latent world models have shown a remarkable ability to predict future states and to plan in the real world. In practice, however, we lack a principled way to estimate how their capabilities scale with model size, data, and compute, an open problem that slows progress in the field. In this work we present RoboJEPA, a world model based on the Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) and trained on a large-scale dataset spanning 12 robotic embodiments. We show that RoboJEPA's imagination error, the error of its latent rollouts, follows a second-order power law in compute, allowing us to predict model quality well beyond the scale at which the law is fit. We further show that downstream robotic planning performance improves predictably with compute, and that imagination error is strongly correlated with it, making it a reliable proxy for real-robot evaluation. Finally, we demonstrate that latent world models can be deployed zero-shot as robotic agents, planning toward a single goal image to solve tasks requiring long-horizon planning on real hardware. We release all model checkpoints together with our training and robot deployment code. To our knowledge, this is the first work to establish scaling laws for multi-embodiment robotic world models trained on real robot data, and RoboJEPA, at 8B parameters, is the largest JEPA predictor model trained to date.

</details>


### [331] [Efficient Dense Crowd Trajectory Prediction Via Dynamic Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.18166)
*Antonius Bima Murti Wijaya,Paul Henderson,Marwa Mahmoud*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于聚类的即插即用方法，通过将相似属性的行人分组并预测群体质心来加速密集人群轨迹预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有轨迹预测方法依赖人工标注数据并逐个预测行人，忽略了密集人群场景中追踪输出量大、噪声高、不精确导致的高计算成本问题。

Method: 提出基于聚类的框架，随时间将相似属性的个体分组，用群体摘要提升执行速度；将输出的质心替代行人输入，可与现有轨迹预测器即插即用结合。在多个困难密集人群场景上广泛评估。

Result: 相比最先进方法，处理更快、内存占用更低，同时保持精度。

Conclusion: 基于聚类的方法能有效应对密集人群预测中的可扩展性问题，兼顾效率与准确性。

Abstract: Crowd trajectory prediction plays a crucial role in public safety and management, where it can help prevent disasters such as stampedes. Recent works address the problem by predicting individual trajectories and considering surrounding objects based on manually annotated data. However, these approaches tend to overlook dense crowd scenarios, where the challenges of automation become more pronounced due to the massiveness, noisiness, and inaccuracy of the tracking outputs, resulting in high computational costs. To address these challenges, we propose and extensively evaluate a novel cluster-based approach that groups individuals based on similar attributes over time, enabling faster execution through accurate group summarisation. Our plug-and-play method can be combined with existing trajectory predictors by using our output centroid in place of their pedestrian input. We evaluate our proposed method on several challenging dense crowd scenes. We demonstrated that our approach leads to faster processing and lower memory usage when compared with state-of-the-art methods, while maintaining the accuracy

</details>


<div id='cs.NE'></div>

# cs.NE [[Back]](#toc)

### [332] [A Connectome Test of the Fly Hashing Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09114)
*Sebastian Senge*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 果蝇嗅觉回路作为随机稀疏投影+赢者通吃实现局部敏感哈希，其相对经典LSH的优势是"每活跃单元"而非"每运算"；真实连接组的接线方式相比保度随机重连并无一致的检索优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2017年Dasgupta等因布线未知而假设果蝇嗅觉回路为随机稀疏投影，本文利用四个电镜连接组检验该假设，探究真实接线是否带来检索优势，以及果蝇哈希相对高斯投影的优势来源。

Method: 在四个电镜连接组（MaleCNS、hemibrain、FlyWire、BANC；四只动物、七个半球）上测试。首先复现2017协议于SIFT、MNIST、气味混合物及GloVe；其次与实值高斯投影基线对比；再比较测量到的肾小球配对与保度随机重连；最后分析肾小球扇出均衡与每细胞输入均衡的影响。

Result: 2017年模式在复现中成立，短哈希长度下果蝇哈希优于k个高斯投影（MNIST上k=4时AP@200提升3.1倍）。但相对高斯投影的优势是每活跃细胞而非每运算：同等投影运算量下高斯投影在所有数据集和维度上检索更优。四个连接组中测量到的肾小球配对相比保度随机重连无一致优势（中位数-1.6%），气味缺陷取决于缺失响应的处理方式。固定连接数下均衡肾小球扇出可提升检索，均衡每细胞输入则平均降低。扇出分布在动物间相似（中位Spearman rho=0.86），突触计数不抵消该效应，与气味调谐关系弱。

Conclusion: 测量到的接线相比保度随机接线无一致检索优势，果蝇哈希无需连接组数据；其优势是每活跃单元，可能适合以活跃单元而非运算为瓶颈成本的硬件（此假设未经验证）。

Abstract: Dasgupta, Stevens and Navlakha (2017) showed that the Drosophila olfactory circuit, modelled as a random sparse projection followed by winner-take-all, is a locality-sensitive hash that beats classical LSH. The projection was random because the wiring was unknown. We test it against four electron-microscopy connectomes (MaleCNS, hemibrain, FlyWire, BANC; four animals, seven hemispheres). First, the 2017 pattern holds in a reimplementation of its protocol on SIFT, MNIST and odour mixtures (GloVe is near chance at short codes for every method): the fly hash beats k Gaussian projections at short hash lengths (3.1x in AP@200 on MNIST at k = 4). Second, against the tested real-valued Gaussian baseline that advantage is per active cell, not per operation: Gaussian projections given the same projection arithmetic retrieve better on every dataset and input dimension tested. Third, across four connectomes the measured pairing of glomeruli gives no consistent retrieval advantage over degree-preserving rewiring: retrieval is slightly lower (median -1.6%), and the small odour deficits depend on how missing odour responses are treated. Separately, equalising glomerular fan-out at fixed connection count improves retrieval in the model in every hemisphere, while equalising inputs per cell lowers it on average. Yet the fan-out profile is similar across the four sampled animals (median between-animal Spearman rho = 0.86), structural synapse counts do not offset it, and its relation to odour tuning is weak. In the model that uneven allocation costs retrieval. For practice: measured wiring gives no consistent retrieval advantage over degree-preserving random wiring, so a fly hash needs no connectome data, and its advantage is per active unit, which may suit hardware where active units rather than arithmetic are the binding cost, a hypothesis we do not test.

</details>


### [333] [Relocating Nonlinearity: How a Downstream Learner Reshapes What Genetic Programming Must Evolve](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09347)
*Nam H. Le*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文研究遗传编程中"程序作为学习者输入"的范式，指出附加的学习者类型决定了程序需自行构建多少非线性；在布尔域上以傅里叶度为非线性度量，发现线性学习者迫使演化程序精确达到目标度数，而树集成以更简单程序、四倍成功率胜出，且程序度数可作为免费诊断指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遗传编程传统上以程序本身为解，但大量工作将程序作为独立学习者的输入，此时适应度衡量的是学习者的输出而非程序输出。选用哪个学习者至关重要，但现有研究缺乏关于"什么决定学习者选择"的解释。作者提出：目标对GP的难度取决于程序须通过组合原语构建的非线性量，而学习者能提供的非线性越多，程序需自行构建的就越少。

Method: 将问题迁移到布尔域，此时目标的非线性恰为其傅里叶度，从而可精确度量。在保持其他条件不变的情况下，把目标度数从1调到6，比较线性学习器与树集成等不同学习者对演化程序所需构建的非线性量的影响，并分析程序自身的度数。

Result: 在成功条件下，线性学习器使演化程序精确达到目标度数（度1至6全部成立，每设置30次运行无一例外）；树集成则以远更简单的程序成功，成功率是前者的四倍。控制目标虽度数低于奇偶问题，却从非线性学习器中毫无获益；而可归约为简单统计量的目标则获益巨大。此外，演化仅在63种条件中的4种内化了学习者提供的非线性，在44种中变得更为依赖学习者——学习者越强，程序中的模型可读性越低。

Conclusion: 本文提供两点贡献：其一，可根据目标结构而非"难度声誉"来选择学习者；其二，演化程序的傅里叶度是一种可在任意运行中免费计算的诊断指标。同时警示：能力越强的学习者会令演化模型越不透明，程序对学习者的依赖增强而内部化不足。

Abstract: Genetic programming was conceived as a way of evolving solutions: the program is the answer, and fitness is the error of its own output. A substantial line of work instead makes the program an input to a separate learner, so fitness measures the learner's output rather than the program's. Which learner to attach matters, with no account of what decides it. What makes a target hard for genetic programming is how much nonlinearity the program must build by composing primitives; whatever nonlinearity the learner supplies, the program need not. The quantity to measure is therefore how much of a target's nonlinearity a learner can take over, though on continuous benchmarks it can only be estimated. Here we show that how much the program must still build is decided by which learner is attached, and is measurable on the programs themselves. Moving to Boolean domains, where a target's nonlinearity is exactly its Fourier degree, we tune that degree from one to six with everything else fixed. Conditioned on success, a linear learner forces the evolved program to the target's degree exactly, at one through six without exception over thirty runs per setting, while tree ensembles succeed with far simpler programs and four times as often. This gives the field two things: a learner can be chosen from a target's structure instead of its reputation for difficulty, and the degree of the evolved program is a diagnostic free to compute during any run. Our control target has lower degree than the parity problems yet gains nothing from a nonlinear learner, while targets reducible to a simple statistic gain a great deal. The latter comes with a warning: evolution internalises what the learner supplies in only four of sixty-three conditions, and grows more dependent on it in forty-four, so the more capable the learner, the less of the model is legible in the program.

</details>


### [334] [The Modular CMA-ES: A Framework for Modern Evolution Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09699)
*Jacob de Nobel,Diederick Vermetten,Anna V. Kononova,Carola Doerr,Thomas Bäck*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文提出模块化CMA-ES框架ModCMA，将现代进化策略的各类机制分解为可互换模块，支持系统化探索和自动配置算法变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代进化策略（如CMA-ES）的各类改进多为孤立提出和研究，机制间的相互作用尚未被充分探索，缺乏统一的框架来系统比较与组合这些设计选择。

Method: 将CMA-ES分解为采样、选择与重组、步长自适应、矩阵自适应、重启等模块，每模块提供可互换选项，整合为单一可配置框架ModCMA；并通过两个示例研究验证：一是比较多种矩阵自适应机制的计算成本与优化性能，二是用自动算法配置将ModCMA特化到不同基准问题并分析所得配置。

Result: 示例研究表明，ModCMA既能用于研究单个算法设计选择，也能以系统、可复现的方式探索其组合，并支持新算法变体的构建、比较与自动配置。

Conclusion: ModCMA为现代进化策略提供了一个模块化、可配置的平台，便于系统化研究机制间的相互作用并进行自动化算法配置。

Abstract: Since their introduction, modern evolution strategies, such as the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES), have become established as powerful methods for continuous black-box optimization. This success has led to a wide range of proposed modifications, each designed to improve performance or behavior in specific optimization scenarios. However, because these developments have largely been introduced and studied in isolation, their interactions remain comparatively underexplored. In this paper, we present the Modular CMA-ES (ModCMA), a configurable framework that integrates a wide range of mechanisms from modern evolution strategies within a single implementation. By decomposing CMA-ES into modules with interchangeable options for sampling, selection and recombination, step-size adaptation, matrix adaptation, and restarting, ModCMA enables systematic exploration of a large design space of modern evolution strategies and facilitates the construction, comparison, and automated configuration of new algorithm variants. We illustrate the benefits of this modular approach through two example studies. First, we compare several matrix-adaptation mechanisms in terms of their computational cost and optimization performance. Second, we use automated algorithm configuration to specialize ModCMA to individual benchmark problems and analyze the resulting configurations. Together, these examples demonstrate how the framework can be used both to study individual algorithmic design choices and to explore their combinations in a systematic and reproducible manner.

</details>


### [335] [Evolutionary Architecture Search for Chlorophyll-$a$ Prediction in Lakes using Sentinel-2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10496)
*Kursat Komurcu,Linas Petkevicius*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 该论文对Sentinel-2藻华分类器进行神经架构搜索，在固定任务、特征与数据划分下，用409参数（比手工设计少26倍）将留出AUC从0.790提升至0.820，精度从0.733提升至0.748。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地球观测领域中，小规模表格数据加专家设计光谱特征是常态，所用网络多为手工设计，作者想探究架构搜索能为这类既有模型带来多大增益。

Method: 固定原始研究的任务、特征与湖泊级训练/测试划分，在扩展的多层感知机空间中用正则化演化进行搜索，仅以内部交叉验证AUC作为选择标准。

Result: 搜索得到的网络将留出AUC从0.790提升到0.820，精度从0.733提升到0.748，仅用409个可训练参数，比最强的<UNKNOWN>手工设计参考模型少26倍；搜索收敛到一致的配方：单窄层、RMS归一化、tanh激活、步进衰减RMSprop与权重平均，模型仅1.6 kB。

Conclusion: 该模型小到可作为星上筛选触发器，正好契合其研究动机；表明架构搜索能为此类操作化地球观测任务带来实用且轻量的改进。

Abstract: Small tabular datasets with expert-designed spectral features are the norm in
  operational Earth observation, and the networks applied to them are typically
  hand-designed. We revisit one such published model -- a Sentinel-2 algal
  bloom classifier -- and ask what architecture search adds, holding the task,
  the features and the lake-level train/test split of the original study fixed.
  Searching an extended multilayer-perceptron space with regularized evolution,
  and selecting on inner-cross-validation AUC only, we find networks that
  improve held-out AUC from 0.790 to 0.820 and accuracy from 0.733 to 0.748
  while using 409 trainable parameters, 26 times fewer than the strongest
  hand-designed reference. The search converges on a consistent recipe -- a
  single narrow layer, RMS normalisation, $\tanh$ activation, step-decayed
  RMSprop and weight averaging -- that a practitioner would be unlikely to
  reach by default. At 1.6\,kB the resulting model is small enough to serve as
  an onboard screening trigger, which is the setting that motivates the work.
  Code: https://github.com/VU-AIML/automl4eo-bloom-nas.

</details>

# cs.SE [[Back]](#toc)

### [336] [Mitigating Uncertainty Interactions in GenAI-based Adaptive Systems: Vision, Challenges and Preliminary Guidelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08881)
*Karthik Vaidhyanathan,Norha Villegas,Raffaela Mirandola,Nicolás Cardozo,Ivana Dusparic,Marin Litoiu,Ralf Reussner,Gabriel Tamura*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一个概念框架，用于刻画和缓解基于GenAI的软件密集系统中的不确定性交互问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GenAI组件（LLM和智能体子系统）引入跨系统层的复合不确定性，其概率性输出、幻觉、上下文窗口限制和记忆陈旧等特性要求重新审视现有的不确定性管理框架，尤其是不确定性之间的交互。

Method: 提出初步概念框架，建立刻画和缓解不确定性交互的准则；强调缓解需覆盖完整软件生命周期（需求分析、设计时决策、运行时适应），无法与执行期监控分析解耦；引入"缓解函数"，将不确定性交互类别、不确定性类型、设计特征、关键性及架构策略映射到质量属性与权衡。

Result: 将框架应用于三个示例用例进行概念验证：LLM服务、AI驱动的软件运维、智能体云管理。

Conclusion: 缓解不确定性交互必须贯穿整个软件生命周期，不能与运行时监控分析解耦，该框架为GenAI系统的自适应不确定性管理提供了初步指引。

Abstract: Modern software-intensive systems increasingly incorporate GenAI components, including LLM and agentic subsystems, which introduce novel and compounding sources of uncertainty across system layers. The self-adaptive systems community has made significant strides in understanding and managing uncertainty. The intrinsic characteristics of GenAI, including probabilistic outputs, hallucinations, context window limitations, and memory staleness, demand a re-examination of existing frameworks and mitigation strategies for dealing with uncertainty, and especially, the interactions among uncertainty occurrences and manifestations. This position paper posits an initial conceptual framework that establishes preliminary guidelines for characterizing and mitigating uncertainty interactions in GenAI-based software-intensive systems. We argue that mitigation must be considered across the full software lifecycle, encompassing requirements analysis, design-time decisions, and run-time adaptations, which implies the unfeasibility of decoupling it from monitoring and analysis at execution. We introduce the notion of a mitigation function that maps uncertainty interaction categories, involved uncertainty types, system design characteristics, criticality, and mitigating architectural tactics to impacted quality attributes and corresponding tradeoffs. As a proof of concept, we apply the framework to three illustrative use cases: LLM serving, AI-driven software operations, and agentic cloud management.

</details>


### [337] [Psychological Safety in Software Engineering Teams: A Systematic Mapping Study of Team Processes and Performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08896)
*Adnan Manzoor,Muhammad Azeem Akbar,Jussi Kasurinen,Muhammad Hamza,Aakash Ahmad,Abdul Razzaq*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过系统映射研究分析112篇软件工程领域心理安全文献，揭示其为多维、情境依赖的团队层面构念，与团队互动和绩效密切相关，但干预措施的有效性与可持续性证据不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心理安全是软件开发团队中重要的人与行为因素，支持协作、知识共享、人际冒险与学习。但软件工程领域的相关证据分散于团队过程、绩效结果、情境条件与障碍之间，缺乏系统整合。

Method: 遵循软件工程系统映射研究指南，分析2006年至2026年6月间发表的112篇原始研究，采用描述性统计与主题分析，围绕六个研究问题展开。

Result: 心理安全是多维、情境依赖的团队层面构念，以人际冒险、开放沟通、协作、学习、信任和支持性互动为特征；主要与生产力、软件质量、创新、团队满意度、协作、沟通和决策相关；受领导力、组织文化、工作环境、信任及社会文化与个体条件影响；常见障碍包括沟通问题、组织约束、领导力问题、多元与包容挑战及工作负荷压力；实践多样但有效性及长期可持续性证据有限。

Conclusion: 心理安全是与团队互动和绩效相关的多维、情境依赖团队构念。研究强调需在软件开发生境中开展纵向、情境敏感的干预研究。

Abstract: Context: Psychological safety is an important human and behavioral factor in software development teams, supporting collaboration, knowledge sharing, interpersonal risk-taking, and learning. However, evidence in software engineering remains fragmented across team processes, performance outcomes, contextual conditions, barriers. Objective: This study maps literature on psychological safety in software engineering, examining its conceptualization, associations with team performance and processes, contextual influences, barriers, and strengthening strategies. Method: We conducted a systematic mapping study following established software engineering guidelines. We analyzed 112 primary studies published between 2006 and June 2026 using descriptive statistics and thematic analysis across six research questions. Results: Psychological safety emerges as a multidimensional, context-dependent, team-level construct characterized by interpersonal risk-taking, open communication, collaboration, learning, trust, and supportive interaction. It is predominantly associated with productivity, software quality, innovation, team satisfaction, collaboration, communication, and decision-making. These relationships are shaped by leadership, organizational culture, work environment, trust, and sociocultural and individual conditions. Recurring barriers include communication problems, organizational constraints, leadership issues, diversity and inclusion challenges, and workload pressures. Although diverse practices are reported, evidence of their effectiveness and long-term sustainability remains limited. Conclusion: Psychological safety is a multidimensional, context-dependent team-level construct associated with team interaction and performance. This study highlights the need for longitudinal, context-sensitive research on psychological safety interventions in software development environments.

</details>


### [338] [Evaluating Change Point Detection Methods for Software Performance Regression Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09023)
*Diego Elias Costa,Michele Tucci,Luca Traini,Daniele Di Pompeo,Thomas Bach,Francois Farquet,David Daly,Simon Eismann,Petr Tůma,Vittorio Cortellessa,André van Hoorn*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文评估了12种变化点检测（CPD）方法在真实软件性能测量数据集上检测性能回归的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 性能问题会侵蚀用户信任、违反SLA并影响业务效率，因此需要在开发早期尽早检测性能回归。CPD方法已在金融、医疗等领域广泛用于自动识别变化，但其在软件性能测量上的有效性尚未被充分评估。

Method: 收集三个大型软件系统的性能测量数据，刻画性能时间序列的独特性质；大规模标注并评估人工标注者识别潜在性能变化的一致性；在此基础上评估12种不同CPD方法检测性能变化的准确性。

Result: 评估了12种CPD方法在真实软件性能数据集上检测潜在性能变化的准确性，并给出其在软件性能回归分析中的适用性与有效性见解。

Conclusion: 该研究为CPD方法在软件性能回归分析中的实际应用提供了实证依据与指导。

Abstract: Performance issues in software systems are a critical quality issue that can erode user trust, violate service-level agreements, and ultimately affect business efficiency. Consequently, software performance engineering has shifted its focus to developing robust techniques to detect performance regressions as early as possible in the development cycle. Performance regression analysis often relies on time series of performance measurements to detect significant changes in performance behavior. Change Point Detection (CPD) methods have been widely used to automate the identification of such changes in various domains, including finance, healthcare, and performance monitoring. However, the effectiveness of these methods for software performance measurements has not been thoroughly evaluated. In this paper, we present a comprehensive study to evaluate the effectiveness of various CPD methods on real-world software performance measurement datasets. We start by collecting performance measurement data from three large software systems and characterizing the unique properties of performance time series data. Then, we undertake a large-scale effort to annotate and evaluate the consistency of human annotators' identification of potential performance changes. Thereafter, we evaluate the accuracy of twelve distinct CPD methods in detecting potential performance changes, providing insights into their applicability and effectiveness in software performance regression analysis.

</details>


### [339] [Large-scale Repository Engineering via Agent-Native Reusable Code Primitives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09079)
*Haibo Jin,Peng Kuang,Xucheng Yu,Jerry Wang,Dehao Wu,Haohan Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 Code Primitives（带接口契约、依赖闭包、测试与溯源的可复用可执行组件）及 CodeFace 库，配合 LEGO 框架与 LEGO-REPO 基准，显著提升仓库级代码构建能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型虽已进入仓库级代码生成阶段，但构建完整仓库仍困难，因为模块、接口、配置、测试与依赖需协同工作，缺乏可复用的组件化方案。

Method: 设计 Code Primitives 作为 agent 原生的可复用执行组件，含接口契约、依赖闭包、验证测试和来源信息，由常驻 LLM 评估相关性并适配实现与依赖；将其组织为 1,424 个验证组件的 CodeFace 库；提出 LEGO 框架，激活任务相关组件、集成适配实现并解决跨组件约束、依据测试迭代修正。

Result: 构建 LEGO-REPO 基准（522 个可执行重建任务，覆盖 7 领域、22 能力轨道、5 难度级别）；最强基线交付分 0.318，41.0% 任务得零分；LEGO 使 13 个骨干平均提升 0.1474，GPT-5.6-terra 从 0.3180 升至 0.5134（+61.4%）；适配组件优于检索上下文或原样引入代码；效果在独立仓库 agent、三个外部基准及重新挖掘的 CodeFace 上均成立；GPT-OSS-20B 适配与诊断保留 95.1% 分数且成本降低 24.0%。

Conclusion: 组件化、可适配的代码原语配合集成与测试反馈能有效提升仓库级构建性能，且具成本与泛化优势。

Abstract: Large language models equipped with development environments have moved code generation toward repository-scale construction, yet building complete repositories remains difficult because interacting modules, interfaces, configurations, tests, and dependencies must work together. We introduce Code Primitives, agent-native reusable executable components with interface contracts, dependency closures, validation tests, and provenance. Each primitive uses a resident LLM to assess relevance and adapt its implementation, interfaces, and dependencies to the target repository, and we organize 1,424 validated primitives in CodeFace, a searchable library for repository construction. We introduce LEGO (Large-scale repository Engineering via aGent-native reusable cOde primitives), which activates task-relevant primitives, integrates their adapted implementations with task-specific code while resolving cross-component constraints, and revises the result against executed tests. To measure construction end to end, we build LEGO-REPO, a benchmark of 522 executable reconstruction tasks spanning seven software domains, 22 capability tracks, and five difficulty levels, scored against native test suites between an empty-package floor and original-source ceiling. The strongest of 13 evaluated backbones reaches a delivery score of 0.318 and scores zero on 41.0% of tasks; LEGO improves all 13 by 0.1474 on average and raises GPT-5.6-terra from 0.3180 to 0.5134 (+61.4%). In controlled comparisons, adapted primitives outperform retrieved code supplied as context or vendored unchanged. The effect persists against independent repository agents, across three external benchmarks, and with a disjointly re-mined CodeFace; GPT-OSS-20B for adaptation and diagnosis retains 95.1% of the homogeneous score at 24.0% lower cost.

</details>


### [340] [Who Broke Me? Execution-Guided Repair of Behavioral Dependency Breaks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09267)
*Juntao Chen,Tingting Bi,Yanlin Wang,Patanamon Thongtanunam*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出BBCFixer，通过在新旧库版本下运行失败测试、对比返回值差异来定位根API，从而筛选库diff作为上游证据，并构建BBCBench基准（100个Python/JS行为破坏案例）。相比无证据的Pure Agent和挖掘文档的BDUpdater，修复成功率最高提升17%，成功修复所需agent步数最多减少27%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 依赖升级可能在不改变库接口的情况下破坏下游项目（行为破坏）。此类问题难以修复：失败测试并不总是指向根API；现有LLM修复方法依赖编译器反馈或库文档，但行为破坏既不产生编译错误，也常缺乏文档；无证据的agent通常也不会主动检索上游证据，导致多数修复失败且无法识别根API。

Method: BBCFixer：在新旧两个库版本下运行失败测试，对各调用的返回值差异进行排序，识别候选根API，再用该候选过滤库diff以获取相关上游证据。同时构建BBCBench，包含Python和JavaScript的100个行为依赖破坏案例。

Result: 在BBCBench上对比两个基线：(1) Pure Agent（无升级证据），(2) BDUpdater（挖掘库文档）。BBCFixer将平均通过率相比Pure Agent最多提升17%，每次成功修复所需agent步数最多减少27%。

Conclusion: BBCFixer提供了定位行为破坏背后上游证据的方法，使LLM agent能够更有效、更高效地修复行为破坏变更。

Abstract: Dependency upgrades can break downstream projects without changing the library interface. Such behavioral breaking changes are difficult for developers to fix, because the failing test does not always point to the root API, the upstream API that causes the break. Existing LLM-based repair methods obtain evidence for the repair from compiler feedback or library documentation. However, a behavioral break produces no compiler feedback and is often undocumented. Agents that receive no upgrade evidence also usually do not retrieve upstream evidence themselves, and most of their failed repairs do not identify the root API.
  The library diff provides useful upstream evidence, but the root API must first be identified to select the relevant part of the diff. We present BBCFixer, a repair method that runs the failing test under the old and new library versions, ranks the calls whose return value differs to identify a candidate root API, and filters the library diff with that candidate. To evaluate repairs of behavioral breaks, we further introduce BBCBench, a benchmark of 100 behavioral dependency breaks in Python and JavaScript.
  We compare BBCFixer on BBCBench with two baselines: (1) Pure Agent, an agent that receives no upgrade evidence, and (2) BDUpdater, a method that mines library documentation. BBCFixer raises the average pass rate by up to 17% relative to Pure Agent and needs up to 27% fewer agent steps per successful repair. BBCFixer thus provides a way to select the upstream evidence behind a behavioral break, so that an LLM agent can repair behavioral breaking changes more effectively and efficiently.

</details>


### [341] [Beyond FAIR: A Fitness Function Framework for Sustainable Research Software](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09580)
*Irdin Pekaric,Philipp Zech*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 扩展研究软件可持续性评估框架，在FAIR原则外增加环境与安全两组适应度函数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FAIR原则虽重要，但未覆盖所有可持续性关切。研究软件还应环境负责且长期安全：过度资源消耗增加环境成本，不安全软件带来维护开销、技术债务和复用障碍。

Method: 在先前提出的可持续研究软件适应度函数框架基础上，引入两组新适应度函数：环境函数（针对资源效率与执行足迹）和安全函数（针对依赖健康、漏洞暴露与安全配置）。

Result: 形成一个将FAIR、环境责任与长期安全统一纳入的评估框架，可支持从FAIR合规到更完整可持续性视角的持续软件评估。

Conclusion: 研究软件可持续性是多维属性，包含FAIR、环境责任和长期安全，新框架提供了更全面的持续评估方式。

Abstract: Research software sustainability is often assessed through the FAIR principles: findability, accessibility, interoperability and reusability. While important, FAIR does not cover all relevant sustainability concerns. Research software should also be environmentally responsible and secure over time. Excessive resource consumption increases environmental cost, while insecure software creates maintenance overhead, technical debt and barriers to reuse. To this end, in this paper, we extend a previously proposed fitness function framework for sustainable research software beyond FAIR. We introduce two additional sets of fitness functions: environmental functions targeting resource efficiency and execution footprint, and security functions targeting dependency health, vulnerability exposure and secure configuration. Together, these functions broaden continuous software assessment from FAIR compliance to a more complete view of sustainability. The resulting framework treats research software sustainability as a multidimensional property that includes FAIR, environmental responsibility and long-term security.

</details>


### [342] [GRAML: Graph-Grounded Reasoning and Multi-Task Learning for LLM-Based Software Vulnerability Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09605)
*Ruohan Li,Miaoqing Tian,Haipeng Qu,Ruobing Jiang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: GRAML结合图证据、漏洞描述生成与多任务训练，提升LLM漏洞检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM漏洞检测性能受限于对控制流和数据流信息利用不足。

Method: 对C/C++程序静态分析提取关键源码行与带类型行关系作为结构证据；用该证据引导GPT-5进行ToT-VR推理生成漏洞描述；将描述与检测、定位、评估样本构建统一四任务训练集。

Result: 在分布内测试集与6个OOD数据集上，平均F1为66.67%–68.70%，超越SOTA基线最多30.92%；消融显示ToT-VR与图引导描述优于标准CoT与原始CPG序列化。

Conclusion: 该框架为构建更可靠安全的LLM软件工程系统提供实践指导。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been widely applied to software vulnerability detection. However, their performance is often limited by insufficient use of control-flow and data-flow information. In this paper, we propose GRAML, a framework that combines graph evidence, vulnerability description generation, and multi-task training. GRAML first performs static analysis on C/C++ programs to extract critical source lines and typed line relations as structural evidence. It then uses this evidence to guide GPT-5 through the Tree-of-Thought-guided Vulnerability Reasoning (ToT-VR) process and generate vulnerability descriptions. These descriptions are further combined with Detection, Localization, and Assessment samples to build a unified four-task training dataset. We evaluate GRAML on an in-distribution (ID) test set and six out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets. The results show that GRAML achieves average F1 scores ranging from 66.67% to 68.70%, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines by up to 30.92%. Ablation experiments further show that ToT-VR and graph-guided vulnerability descriptions improve detection performance compared with standard Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning and raw Code Property Graph (CPG) serializations. These findings provide practical guidance for building more reliable and secure software engineering systems with large language models.

</details>


### [343] [A Chat Assistant for Software Exploration in a 3D Software Visualization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09901)
*Malte Hansen,Karim Issa,Wilhelm Hasselbring*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出集成于3D软件可视化工具ExplorViz的聊天助手，基于LLM并结合CopilotKit实现确定性工具调用，支持自然语言查询与可视化操作。11人实验显示摘要/解释准确、可用性高，但开放式重构效果混合，需加强护栏与用户反馈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索性程序理解任务中交互开销较大，需要更自然的交互方式来降低用户操作负担并支持软件系统探索。

Method: 基于LLM构建聊天助手并嵌入ExplorViz前端，利用CopilotKit将概率性LLM与确定性、工具化操作结合（类似MCP），支持高亮实体、创建配色主题及增删改软件系统结构等操作。

Result: 11名参与者实验表明：助手生成的摘要与解释被认为基本正确，高亮实体和创建主题等操作可用性评分高；但聊天辅助的开放式软件重构结果混合，暴露LLM护栏不足与用户反馈整合欠缺。

Conclusion: 该助手总体可用，有潜力降低探索性程序理解中的交互开销；未来需强化LLM护栏并更好融入用户反馈，同时提供了演示视频与复现包。

Abstract: We present a chat assistant for interactive software exploration, embedded in the 3D software visualization tool ExplorViz. The assistant builds upon current Large Language Models (LLMs) and enables users to ask questions about the currently visualized software system and trigger actions that change the visualization through natural language. We integrate the chat assistant in our ExplorViz frontend using the CopilotKit libraries such that probabilistic LLMs are combined with deterministic and tool-based actions similar to implementations using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). The chat assistant is also enabled to restructure the software system by adding, removing, or modifying parts of the software system in the visualization. An empirical experiment with eleven participants evaluated both perceived comprehension support and the tool calls that were triggered by the chat assistant. Participants rated the assistant's generated summaries and explanations as largely correct. They also reported high usability for actions like highlighting entities in the visualization and the creation of new color themes. In contrast, open-ended chat-assisted software restructuring in the visualization showed mixed results. This suggests a need for stronger guardrails for the employed LLM and better incorporation of user feedback. Overall, the assistant was perceived as usable and promising for reducing interaction overhead during exploratory program comprehension tasks. We provide a video presenting the chat assistant's use and a reproduction package of the software system that was used in our evaluation.

</details>


### [344] [Analysis and Visualization of the Linux Kernel's Software Evolution Using the City Metaphor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09910)
*Malte Hansen,Lukas Damerau,Moritz Bugla,David Moreno-Lumbreras,Wilhelm Hasselbring*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出利用软件可视化工具Exploviz，将Linux内核结构以3D城市隐喻呈现，并支持代码演化分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Linux内核规模庞大（超4000万行代码），理解其内部结构与软件演化极具挑战。

Method: 通过自定义分析服务解析Linux Git仓库提交，Web端以3D城市隐喻可视化软件结构；为每个文件收集代码行数等指标并聚合到目录和提交，映射到建筑尺寸或热力图，提供搜索与过滤交互功能。

Result: 展示了两类可视化：内核仓库全部文件的可视化，以及Linux内核中Rust文件代码演化的视觉分析。

Conclusion: 该工具可帮助研究者交互式探索Linux内核结构与演化，并附有演示视频。

Abstract: The Linux kernel is one of the largest and longest-maintained open source projects in existence. With more than 40 million lines of code, understanding the kernel's internal structure and assessing its software evolution is a great challenge. In this paper, we present an approach to visualize the Linux kernel using our software visualization tool ExplorViz. We analyze commits from the Linux Git repository using a custom analysis service. The web-based frontend utilizes the 3D city metaphor for visualization of the software structure. Metrics such as the number of lines are collected for each file and are accumulated for directories and commits. Calculated metrics can be mapped to the building's dimensions or be displayed via a heat map. A wide range of visualization, search, and filter options enable the interactive exploration of the visualized data. We present both a visualization of all files in the kernel repository and a visual analysis of the code evolution of Rust files in the Linux kernel. Demo video: https://youtu.be/3ODnERqD8g0

</details>


### [345] [AgentTracer: Tracing Indirect Prompt Injection Attack through Fine-Grained Intention-Execution Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09935)
*Zitong Yao,Jiangrong Wu,Yixi Lin,Anrui Huang,Luoyun Zhang,Yuhong Nan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: AgentTracer：一个意图感知的追踪框架，将间接提示注入(IPI)视为任务意图漂移，通过构建意图驱动执行图来重建攻击链并定位注入源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent与外部资源交互易受间接提示注入(IPI)攻击，恶性指令会重定向agent任务。现有追踪方法主要捕捉显式控制流和数据流依赖，忽略了恶意指令驱动的工具调用间的隐式关系，这些调用缺乏显式依赖且与合法操作交错，导致攻击链难以完整重建。

Method: 提出AgentTracer意图感知追踪框架，将IPI视为任务意图漂移。它恢复工具调用间的隐式决策依赖，构建意图驱动执行图(Intent-Driven Execution Graph)，按任务意图连接分散的工具调用；结合用户请求与操作知识库构建用户意图授权空间，识别意图漂移的工具调用；从审计下的异常工具调用出发，进行基于目标的剪枝和反向追踪以重建攻击链并定位注入源和注入点。

Result: 将AgentDyn和InjecAgent中成功IPI攻击的执行日志与含1800个用户请求、9000个无IPI背景工具调用的正常日志结合进行评估。端到端实验中，AgentTracer达到94.17%的注入点准确率和93.56%的路径精确度，注入点准确率较现有方法提升18%至54%。

Conclusion: AgentTracer通过意图感知的隐式依赖追踪有效解决了IPI攻击链重建难题，在含噪声环境下显著优于现有方法，为LLM agent的事后追踪提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents interact with external resources to complete complex user tasks, exposing them to indirect prompt injection (IPI), where malicious instructions redirect agents toward attacker-intended tasks. Since IPI is difficult to defend against in real-world environments, post-incident tracing is essential for locating the injection source and reconstructing the attack chain. However, existing tracing methods primarily capture explicit control-flow and data-flow dependencies, overlooking the implicit relationships among tool calls driven by the malicious instruction. These tool calls may lack explicit dependencies and be interleaved with legitimate operations, making complete attack-chain reconstruction difficult. In this paper, we present AgentTracer, an intent-aware tracing framework that treats IPI as task intent drift. AgentTracer recovers implicit decision dependencies among tool calls to construct an Intent-Driven Execution Graph that connects dispersed tool calls by task intent. It combines the user request with an operation knowledge base to construct a user intent authorization space and identify intent-drift tool calls. Starting from an anomalous tool call under audit, AgentTracer performs target-based pruning and backward tracing to reconstruct the attack chain and locate the injection source and injection point. To evaluate AgentTracer in the presence of noise from normal tasks, we combine execution logs constructed from successful IPI attacks in AgentDyn and InjecAgent with normal execution logs containing 1,800 user requests and 9,000 background tool calls without IPI. In end-to-end experiments, AgentTracer achieves 94.17 percent injection-point accuracy and 93.56 percent path precision. Comparative experiments show that AgentTracer improves injection-point accuracy over existing methods by 18 to 54 percent.

</details>


### [346] [Designing Collaborative AI-Driven Workflows for Scientific Software Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09995)
*Akash Dhruv,Max Knobbe,Pedro Machado,Anshu Dubey*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文主张将智能体AI用于协作团队结构而非完全自动化，在科学计算中通过确定性编排与人审流程验证代理生成代码，并以大型高能物理Fortran到C++翻译为例进行评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学计算中，验证智能体生成的代码既正确又能被跨领域团队理解是核心难点，因此不适合完全自动化。

Method: 提出协作工作流：领域专家编写规范与计划；智能体在确定性编排模式下编写目标代码；每阶段与参考代码进行数值对比，并经人工审核批准后进入下一阶段。以大型高能物理应用从Fortran到C++的翻译为评测任务，在14个实验中改变编排器、设计模式和模型。

Result: 在14个实验中，简单的“作者—审阅者”循环（带强制限制）完成了与多智能体工作流相当数量的文件，且每文件成本约为其三分之一。

Conclusion: 智能体AI应嵌入协作团队结构并配合确定性编排、数值校验与人审；简单作者—审阅者循环在成本效率上优于多智能体工作流。

Abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence systems can carry out a broad range of tasks in software engineering and scientific research, from writing and translating code to running workflows for data analysis and visualization. In scientific computing, the difficulty is verifying that agent-generated code is both correct and understandable to teams whose members bring different areas of expertise. We therefore argue that these systems are best used within collaborative team structures rather than as full automation. In the workflows we propose, domain experts write the specification and plan, and agents operate under a deterministic orchestration pattern to write the target code. Each stage ends with a numerical comparison against the reference code and requires human review and approval before the next begins. We evaluate these workflows on the translation of a large high-energy physics application from Fortran to C++, running the same task under different orchestrators, design patterns, and models. Across fourteen experiments, a simple author--reviewer loop with enforced limits completed a comparable number of files to a multi-agent workflow at about one-third of the cost per file.

</details>


### [347] [AdaT$^2$: Adaptive Test Transformations for Black-Box Boundary Testing of Conversational Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10141)
*Liting Lin,Boxi Yu,Qinghua Xu,Yuzhong Zhang,Lionel Briand,Emir Muñoz*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: AdaT^2 通过探索对话抽取条件语句并自适应生成变形测试，有效检测 LLM 对话代理的策略边界违规。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话代理需遵守策略，但策略每条条件界定了用户请求的边界，代理在边界两侧需行为不同。现有方法难以生成有效边界测试，故需自动化测试以验证合规性。

Method: AdaT^2 从 LLM 扮演用户的探索对话回复中抽取陈述（描述条件与期望行为），结合测试变形指令生成普通测试与变形测试。通过新颖性选择和 Bayes-UCB 多臂老虎机自适应配对，利用 LLM 判定器反馈学习有效性。

Result: 在 τ^3-bench 四个领域，62.7%–83.3% 的测试为有效边界测试，高于 AgentEval（47.7%–68.1%）；变形测试额外发现 13–46 个显式边界。回归测试中，AdaT^2 于航空域检测出全部 8 个缺陷，零售域 4/8；AgentEval 测试数不足三分之一，仅检出 5 和 2 个。

Conclusion: AdaT^2 能更全面、高效地生成策略边界测试，提升 LLM 对话代理的合规性与回归缺陷检测能力。

Abstract: Conversational agents based on large language models (LLMs) must comply with policies. Each condition in a policy draws a boundary between user requests, and the agent must behave differently on its two sides. We present AdaT$^2$, which extracts statements from the agent's replies in exploratory conversations with an LLM acting as the user, and uses the statements to guide boundary test generation. Each statement describes one condition and the behavior expected when the condition holds. Besides plain tests guided by single statements, AdaT$^2$ writes transformed tests guided by pairs of a statement and a test transformation instruction, such as "omit one required input". The instruction of a pair can move a test to the other side of the statement's boundary or to another boundary. The statements and instructions form far more pairs than a run can try, and many pairs are not applicable. Adaptive pair selection therefore chooses the statement of each pair by novelty and the instruction with the bandit algorithm Bayes-UCB, which learns from whether earlier pairs yielded a test and whether the agent passed it according to an LLM judge. Our benchmark counts the two sides of each boundary separately and distinguishes boundaries explicitly defined by the agent's prompt, tool code, or knowledge base from boundaries that the agent's LLM infers from domain knowledge. On four domains of $τ^3$-bench, 62.7% to 83.3% of AdaT$^2$'s tests are valid boundary tests whose expected behavior is explicitly defined, higher in every domain than AgentEval's (47.7% to 68.1%). Transformed tests add 13 to 46 explicitly defined boundaries that plain tests miss. As regression tests, AdaT$^2$'s test suites detect all eight seeded policy faults in the airline domain and four of eight in the retail domain, and AgentEval's test suites, with fewer than a third as many tests, detect five and two, respectively.

</details>


### [348] [Why Software Engineering Is Indispensable in the Age of Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10226)
*Alfonso Fuggetta*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文论证AI无法取代软件工程与软件工程师：LLM的三个结构性属性造成"结构真空"，需四类知识杠杆填补，而软件工程师正是这些知识的承载者与守护者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对"AI是否会让软件工程学科过时、软件工程师冗余"的争论，作者提出反驳立场：AI辅助开发若缺少软件工程基础，会产生看似合理却不可验证、不可信的软件。

Method: 以理论论证为主，识别大语言模型的三个结构性属性——概率生成、不可知性（agnosticism）与语义无状态性（semantic statelessness），指出它们形成训练无法消除的"结构真空"，并据此提出四类知识杠杆及软件工程师的三种角色。

Result: 指出LLM的结构性缺陷无法仅靠训练弥补；填补真空需方法知识、领域知识、设计选择与过程选择四类杠杆，且都必须被物化为持久性工件。

Conclusion: 软件工程与软件工程师是AI辅助开发的必要基础而非冗余：软件工程师须担任方法论者、中介者与守护者，将四类知识固化为持久工件，从而保障软件的可验证性与可信度。

Abstract: Can AI make Software Engineering (SE) -- the discipline -- obsolete? And can it make software engineers -- the professionals -- redundant? This paper argues that the rise of capable AI coding agents makes SE and software engineers essential, not obsolete: the missing foundation without which AI-assisted development produces misleadingly plausible, unverifiable, and ultimately untrustworthy software. Three structural properties of large language models (probabilistic generation, agnosticism, and semantic statelessness) create a structural vacuum that no amount of training can eliminate. Filling it requires four knowledge levers: methodological knowledge, domain knowledge, design choices, and process choices. All four must be reified as persistent artifacts, and each requires the software engineer as methodologist, mediator, and custodian.

</details>


### [349] [TestGRAD: Evolving Test Suites via Failure Pattern Momentum for SWE-Agent Ensemble](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10242)
*Pengfei He,Jiayuan Zhou,Shaowei Wang,Ruiqi Pan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: TestGRAD 是一个面向 SWE-agent 集成的自动化测试优化框架，通过差分损失、全 CRUD 梯度和失败模式动量来进化测试套件，以区分竞争性补丁。在 SWE-bench Verified 上，4-agent 集成达到 84.2% Pass@1，超过最强基线（80.6%）3.6 个百分点，并将失败历史上下文压缩超过 100 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SWE-agent 集成依赖基于测试的补丁选择，需要生成测试并执行候选补丁以选出最优补丁。然而现有测试生成方法作为优化器存在局限：缺乏面向集成选择的显式损失、优化方向不完整（大多只是新建或删除测试）、且为一次性生成，无法从反复失败中获取反馈。

Method: 受带动量的梯度下降启发，提出 TestGRAD 框架，核心为三个概念：(1) 差分损失（Differential loss），以执行定义显式目标，使有用测试能按行为区分候选补丁；(2) 全 CRUD 梯度（Full CRUD gradients），将更新方向从仅创建/删除扩展为读取现有测试基础设施、创建新测试、更新过时断言、仅删除废弃测试；(3) 失败模式动量（Failure Pattern Momentum），从记忆中挖掘频繁失败序列，避免重复非判别性方向并压缩失败历史上下文。

Result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 上，TestGRAD 在 4-agent 集成下取得 84.2% Pass@1，相较最强基线（80.6%）绝对提升 3.6 个百分点，同时将失败历史上下文压缩超过 100 倍。

Conclusion: TestGRAD 将测试选择形式化为测试空间优化，通过差分损失、全 CRUD 梯度与失败模式动量，显著提升集成补丁选择的准确率并大幅压缩上下文，验证了该优化视角的有效性。

Abstract: SWE-agent ensembles improve issue resolution by combining candidate patches from different agents with complementary strengths. The central problem is therefore test-based selection: generate tests, execute candidate patches, and identify the best patch. We formulate this process as test-space optimization: evolving an executable repository test suite until it distinguishes competing patches. Existing test-generation methods are limited optimizers. They usually lack an explicit loss for ensemble selection, optimize through incomplete directions that mostly create new tests or delete old ones, and perform one-off generation without feedback from repeated failures. Inspired by gradient descent with momentum, we introduce TestGRAD, a framework for automatic test optimization. TestGRAD centers on three concepts. Differential loss gives the optimizer an explicit execution-defined target: useful tests should separate candidate patches by behavior. Full CRUD gradients expand the update direction from merely creating or deleting tests to reading existing test infrastructure, creating new tests, updating stale assertions, and deleting only obsolete tests. Failure Pattern Momentum mines frequent failure sequences from memory, allowing the optimizer to avoid repeated non-discriminative directions while compressing the failure-history context. On SWE-bench Verified, TestGRAD achieves 84.2% Pass@1 with a 4-agent ensemble, outperforming the strongest baseline (80.6%) by an absolute improvement of 3.6 percentage points, while compressing failure-history context by over $100\times$.

</details>


### [350] [QuSema: Detecting Silent Bugs in Quantum Libraries via Quantum-knowledge-enhanced Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10258)
*Yujin Song,Kaining Zhang,Qixin Zhang,Shuai Wang,Pingchuan Ma,Yuxuan Du*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: QuSema：用量子语义与文档作为源码级语义预言，通过自主智能体循环检测量子库中的静默bug。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子库是关键基础设施，但现有测试依赖失败型或对比型预言，适用性受限，易漏检不崩溃的静默bug，导致错误结果传播。

Method: 以量子语义和文档约束作为源码级语义预言，通过智能体循环反复检查API文档与源码、推理量子操作意图行为、识别语义偏差，并通过库API生成可执行测试验证。

Result: 在Qiskit和PennyLane上实现；20个历史静默bug基准上，平均bug重定位数高于Claude Code和Codex，DeepSeek配置成本低于Claude Code；发现40个经开发者确认的新bug，含30个静默bug。

Conclusion: QuSema能有效发现执行不失败或无可比对的静默bug，将高层行为不匹配转化为用户可触发的具体bug报告。

Abstract: Quantum libraries are now critical infrastructure for quantum algorithm development, yet their correctness remains difficult to test. Existing testing techniques mainly rely on failure-based or comparison-based oracles, exposing bugs only when executions fail, violate runtime checks, or disagree with another implementation. Their applicability is limited when suitable execution-based oracles are unavailable, leaving some silent bugs undetected. Such missed bugs can produce incorrect results that propagate into experimental conclusions, simulation studies, and algorithmic designs. Here we present QuSema, an autonomous testing agent for finding silent bugs in quantum libraries. QuSema uses constraints from quantum semantics and documentation as a source-level semantic oracle to assess whether implementation logic can produce invalid outputs from valid inputs. It operates through an agentic loop that repeatedly inspects library API documentation and source code, reasons about the intended behavior of quantum operations, identifies potential semantic deviations, and validates them by generating executable tests through library APIs. Guided by quantum-domain reasoning, QuSema turns high-level behavioral mismatches into concrete, user-triggerable bug reports, enabling it to uncover non-crash defects. We implement QuSema for Qiskit and PennyLane. On a benchmark of 20 historical silent bugs, QuSema achieves higher mean bug relocation counts than Claude Code and Codex, with the DeepSeek configuration costing less than Claude Code. QuSema also discovers 40 previously unknown bugs confirmed by the developers, including 30 silent bugs.

</details>


### [351] [Using Small Language Models to Reverse-Engineer Machine Learning Pipelines Structures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10261)
*Nicolas Lacroix,Frederic Precioso,Mireille Blay-Fornarino,Sebastien Mosser*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 评估小型语言模型(SLM)能否用于从源代码中提取ML流水线阶段，以替代不可扩展的人工标注或领域适应性差的分类器。研究表明分类法用词显著影响性能，最佳SLM结果良好但未超越现有分类器，不同方法导致的ML实践洞察存在显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从源代码中提取ML流水线阶段（如数据预处理、建模）有助于理解ML实践。但ML领域（算法、数据集等）不断演化带来多样性，现有方法依赖不可扩展的人工标注或无法充分支持领域多样性的分类器，需要更可靠的解决方案。

Method: 采用验证性研究，基于两篇代表当前SOTA局限的参考工作。先用Cochran's Q检验比较多个SLM，再用两项McNemar检验将最佳模型与参考研究对比；另用Cochran's Q检验考察分类法定义变化对SLM性能的影响；最后用拟合优度检验比较SLM分类与先前研究得出的ML实践洞察。

Result: 一、分类法用词显著影响分类性能；二、表现最佳的SLM结果良好，但未超越其他分类器；三、三种分类方法在探索数据科学家实践时得出显著不同的洞察，且效应量各异。

Conclusion: 现有分类方法的局限会偏差我们对ML实践的理解。当前SLM在无需微调情况下展现出潜力，但仍存在常见局限，且推理成本高，影响其在大规模研究中的适用性。

Abstract: Context: Once defined a taxonomy of stages structuring Machine Learning (ML) pipelines (e.g. Data Preprocessing, Modeling...), extracting these stages from source code is key for better understanding ML practices. However, the diversity caused by the constant evolution of ML (e.g., algorithms, datasets) makes this task challenging. Existing approaches either rely on non-scalable manual labeling or on classifiers that do not properly support domain's diversity. These limitations call for more reliable solutions.
  Objective: We evaluate whether Small Language Models (SLMs) can leverage their code understanding and classification abilities to address these limitations, and enhance our understanding of practices in ML.
  Method: We conduct a confirmatory study based on two relevant reference works representing current limitations in the state-of-the-art. We first compare several SLMs using Cochran's Q test, then evaluate the best-performing model against reference studies via two McNemar's tests. An additional Cochran's Q test examines how taxonomy definition variations affect the SLM performance. Finally, goodness-of-fit tests compare ML practice insights from SLM classification with those from prior studies.
  Results: First, we found that the taxonomy wording significantly impacts classification performance. Second, the best performing SLM yielded good results, yet, without outperforming other classifiers. Third, the three classification methods led to significantly different insights, with varying effect sizes, when exploring practices of data scientists.
  Conclusions: Limitations of existing classification methods bias our understanding of ML practices. While current SLMs show promising results without prior fine-tuning, they still exhibit common limitations, in addition to inference high costs challenging their applicability in large-scale studies.

</details>


### [352] [When Sub-Agents Work in Parallel: The Promises and Pitfalls of Dynamic Concurrency in Long-Horizon Coding Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10263)
*Han Li,HanHaoNing Li,Ziqian Jiang,Yiling Lou*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 研究动态并发(动态生成子代理)作为编码代理的执行策略。通过对比Codex、Claude Code、Kimi Code启用/禁用该策略的2124次执行,分析其端到端效果、调度行为及13种并发特有失败模式,揭示其优势条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码代理从有界任务迈向长周期开发,动态并发有望扩展复杂任务规模,但现有研究多关注短任务失败或预设多代理协作,对前沿代理在不同复杂度下的动态并发缺乏认识。

Method: 对Codex、Claude Code、Kimi Code进行匹配的受控对比,启用或禁用动态并发策略,覆盖354个任务、2124次执行,评估端到端效果与调度行为,并分析匹配轨迹。

Result: 刻画了13种并发特有失败模式、28种可观察模式,并识别出动态并发提供优势的条件。

Conclusion: 动态并发效果依赖于执行策略与任务条件;模型能力主导短任务表现,而长周期开发中编排成为任务完成的关键。

Abstract: As coding agents advance from bounded software engineering tasks toward long horizon development, dynamic concurrency offers a promising way to scale complex development tasks. Under this policy, agents decide during execution whether and how to spawn concurrent sub-agents. Model capability largely determines outcomes on shorter tasks, whereas long horizon development makes orchestration central to task completion. Existing work, focused on coding agent failures on shorter tasks or collaboration in predefined multiagent workflows, offers little insight into dynamic concurrency in frontier agents across task complexity. We study dynamic concurrency as an execution policy through controlled comparisons of matched Codex, Claude Code, and Kimi Code executions with the policy enabled or disabled. Across 354 tasks and 2,124 executions spanning a range of task complexities and execution horizons, we evaluate its end to end effects and scheduling behavior, and analyze matched trajectories to characterize 13 concurrency specific failure modes, 28 observable patterns, and the conditions under which it provides an advantage.

</details>


### [353] [TaoD2C-Bench: Benchmarking MLLMs for Industrial UI Code Generation Beyond Visual Fidelity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10374)
*Chengwei Shi,Yunnong Chen,Tingting Zhou,Qiang Lu,Shiyu Yue,Xinyuan Hu,Jianfang Ru,Liuqing Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出TaoD2C-Bench基准，用于评估MLLM在工业UI设计转代码（D2C）中约束感知的跨模态推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM的关键挑战是从视觉识别转向约束感知的跨模态推理，工业D2C需要将设计图与图层元数据结合并在目标库约束下生成代码，但此类能力在真实工业场景中评估不足。

Method: 构建TaoD2C数据集（17个商业平台2861个生产设计，97652条专家标注，涵盖Component、Group、Alignment、Position四类，区分必需约束与允许选项）；定义三个任务：端到端UI代码生成、需求推理、需求实现。

Result: 评估8个MLLM，发现在满足实现需求的UI代码生成上存在显著差距，推理与实现表现各异；视觉重建能力并不必然意味着能生成满足需求的代码。

Conclusion: TaoD2C的发布将支持工业UI代码生成研究。

Abstract: A key challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is moving beyond visual recognition to constraint-aware cross-modal reasoning. This involves combining visual cues with information from other modalities to understand elements' relationships under domain-specific rules. This challenge is acutely evident in industrial design-to-code (D2C), which converts user interface (UI) designs into code and requires MLLMs to connect design images with disorganized layer metadata, infer component and layout implementation requirements, and realize them in code under target-library constraints. However, these capabilities remain insufficiently evaluated in realistic industrial settings. To fill this gap, we present TaoD2C-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs' ability to generate UI code that satisfies implementation requirements in industrial applications. The TaoD2C dataset consists of 2,861 production designs from 17 commercial platforms with 97,652 expert annotations across four categories: Component, Group, Alignment, and Position. These annotations distinguish required constraints from permitted implementation choices. TaoD2C-Bench defines three tasks: end-to-end UI code generation, requirement inference, and requirement realization. Evaluating eight MLLMs reveals substantial gaps in generating UI code that satisfies implementation requirements, alongside distinct performance profiles in inference and realization. We further show that MLLMs' visual reconstruction ability does not necessarily imply an ability to generate code that meets these requirements. We release TaoD2C to support research on industrial UI code generation.

</details>

### [354] [Open problem: Computing the optimal deterministic budget-balanced mechanism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08795)
*Vincent Conitzer*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该文提出一个自动机制设计领域的开放问题：能否在多项式时间内计算最优的确定性预算平衡机制，并讨论了若干相关变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该问题源于2015年秋季Simons计算理论研究所"经济学与计算"项目期间提出的开放问题，关注自动机制设计中确定性预算平衡机制的最优计算复杂度。

Method: 这是一篇开放问题性质的论文，主要提出并阐述问题及其变体，未涉及具体算法或证明方法。

Result: 该问题及其变体目前仍为公开未解问题。

Conclusion: 呼吁研究者在自动机制设计领域探索确定性预算平衡最优机制的多项式时间可计算性问题。

Abstract: This is an open problem originally posed during the program "Economics and Computation" held in the Fall 2015 semester at the Simons Institute for the Theory of Computing. It asks whether, in automated mechanism design, it is possible to compute the optimal deterministic budget-balanced mechanism in polynomial time. Some variants, also open to my knowledge, are also discussed.

</details>


### [355] [Open problem: Computing Bayes-Nash equilibrium in simple security games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08796)
*Vincent Conitzer*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文提出一个开放问题：Bayesian简单安全博弈的(Bayes-)Nash均衡能否在多项式时间内计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该问题源于2015年秋季Simons计算理论研究所"Economics and Computation"项目，属于计算博弈论中的开放问题。

Method: 提出理论性开放问题，探讨Bayesian简单安全博弈中均衡计算的计算复杂性。

Result: 尚未给出具体结果，仅明确了待解决的计算复杂性问题。

Conclusion: Bayesian简单安全博弈的均衡计算复杂性仍是一个未解决的开放问题。

Abstract: This is an open problem originally posed during the program "Economics and Computation" held in the Fall 2015 semester at the Simons Institute for the Theory of Computing. It asks whether a (Bayes-)Nash equilibrium can be computed in polynomial time for Bayesian simple security games.

</details>


### [356] [The Confidence Game: Strategic Miscalibration in Human-AI Delegation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09371)
*Raghu Arghal,Saswati Sarkar,Shirin Saeedi Bidokhti*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文将AI智能体的置信度报告建模为重复信号博弈（Confidence Game），刻画两期Markov完美贝叶斯均衡，并通过LLM实验证明激励机制导致置信度系统性扭曲、破坏委托收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体的校准不确定性对可信赖性至关重要，但当智能体追求用户参与度或收入最大化时，其置信度报告可能被策略性扭曲，降低信息价值。论文旨在将置信度报告形式化为委托场景下的策略问题。

Method: 构建Confidence Game：诚实性和能力未知的智能体报告置信度，用户决定委托或自行完成任务，属不完美监听的重复信号博弈，智能体需权衡信号操纵与声誉维护。求解两期Markov完美贝叶斯均衡，并将LLM置于智能体角色、赋予真实成功概率以隔离激励因素。

Result: 诚实报告非均衡；智能体足够短视时通胀是唯一最优反应；低报需用户认为诚实为少数。LLM在被告知大概率失败的任务上有56%报告高置信。真实任务中误校准加剧、信号信息量下降。LLM决策一致但系统性低估用户委托概率与自身声誉稳固度，行为不够极端。定价显示扭曲摧毁68%委托收益，其中71%为报告不再携带的信息，用户再精明也无法恢复。

Conclusion: 论文确立委托下的置信度报告为策略性问题，提供可处理的基础用于建模、分析和测试智能体行为。

Abstract: Calibrated uncertainty quantification is essential to ensuring AI agents are trustworthy and reliable. However, when agents seek to maximize user engagement or revenue, confidence reports may be strategically distorted, detracting from their informativeness. We formalize this problem in the Confidence Game: a repeated signaling game with imperfect monitoring in which an agent of unknown honesty and ability reports its confidence, and a user decides whether to delegate the task or complete it herself. The agent manages the tradeoff between manipulating signals and maintaining its reputation. We characterize the Markov Perfect Bayesian Equilibria of the two-period game and show that honest reporting is not an equilibrium, inflation is the unique best response once the agent is sufficiently myopic, and under-reporting requires that the user believe honesty to be a minority. We then place an LLM in the agent role, supplying it with its true probability of success so that any gap between what it knows and what it reports is attributable to incentives rather than to miscalibration. The model claims high confidence on 56% of tasks it has been told it will probably fail. This persists on real tasks, where it must estimate its own accuracy and causes miscalibration to increase while the agent's signal becomes less informative. Furthermore, we find that the LLM agent's decisions are coherent, but it systematically underestimates both how likely the user is to delegate and how secure its reputation is, resulting in less extreme behavior. Pricing the agent's reporting rule, we find that it destroys 68% of the gains from delegation, of which 71% is information the report no longer carries and no amount of user sophistication recovers. Overall, we establish confidence reporting under delegation as a strategic problem and provide a tractable basis for modeling, analyzing, and testing agent behavior.

</details>


### [357] [Envy-free Allocations with Individual Payments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09610)
*Robert Bredereck,Eva Deltl,Tanmay Inamdar,Pallavi Jain,Pranjal Pandey*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究个体预算下通过代理间转移支付实现无嫉妒分配的复杂性，证明判断可行性多项式可解但计算分配NP难，并进行参数化分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有带补贴的公平分配研究通常假设支付来自外部来源，这一假设在许多应用中不现实。本文允许仅在代理之间进行货币转移，且每个代理的支付受其个人预算约束。

Method: 允许代理间货币转移（无外部补贴），每个代理的支付受个体预算限制。判断给定分配能否通过预算内支付变为无嫉妒，并研究从头计算此类分配的复杂度；随后进行参数化复杂度分析。

Result: 判断给定分配能否通过个体预算内支付实现无嫉妒是多项式时间可解的；但从头计算此类分配的问题是NP难的，即使代理预算相对较大。参数化方面：以物品数量为参数、或以代理数与物品种类的联合参数为参数，问题是固定参数可解的；若干特殊情况下给出高效算法。

Conclusion: 个体预算下的代理间转移支付公平分配：可行性判定易解、构造难解；参数化算法可行，且基于类型的算法回答了Nguyen和Rothe开放问题中关于无嫉妒性的部分。

Abstract: When an envy-free allocation of indivisible goods does not exist, monetary transfers can restore envy-freeness. Existing work on fair division with subsidies, however, typically assumes that these payments are provided by an external source, an assumption that may be unrealistic in many applications. We address this limitation by allowing only monetary transfers between agents, with each agent's payments constrained by their individual budget. We show that while it is polynomial-time tractable to determine whether a given allocation can be made envy-free by payments under individual budgets, the general problem of computing such an allocation from scratch is NP-hard, even when agents have relatively large budgets.
  Motivated by this intractability, we conduct a parameterized complexity analysis, establishing fixed-parameter tractability with respect to the number of goods or to the joint parameter number of agents and good types, and we provide efficient algorithms in several special cases. For explicitly listed items, our type-based algorithm answers the envy-freeness part of an open question of T. T. Nguyen and J. Rothe, "Complexity Results and Exact Algorithms for Fair Division of Indivisible Items: A Survey."

</details>


### [358] [Optimal Regret for Online Market Making with Limit Order Book](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09691)
*Maria Elena Vischi,Francesco Emanuele Stradi,Alberto Marchesi*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究在线做市学习，在有限订单簿反馈下将后悔界从Õ(T^{2/3})改进为高概率Õ(√T)，并证明完全对抗环境下无法实现次线性后悔。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Maran等2026在限价订单簿反馈模型下仅得到Õ(T^{2/3})期望后悔界，且对反馈更弱的情形与对抗环境的可学习性边界尚不清晰。

Method: 先研究全反馈设置，基于两个耦合网格对买卖价空间离散化并结合Hedge算法；再扩展到限价订单簿诱导的更弱反馈，设计达到相同保证的算法。

Result: 在全反馈和限价订单簿反馈下均实现高概率Õ(√T)后悔界；并证明当市场价格与交易者估值均为对抗性选择时，即使全反馈也无法实现次线性后悔。

Conclusion: 改进了做市在线学习的后悔保证并从反面论证了对估值采用随机假设的必要性。

Abstract: We study online learning in market making, where, at each round, a market maker posts bid and ask prices before observing the market price and the private valuation of an incoming trader. In this setting, Maran et al. 2026 introduce a feedback model motivated by limit order books, in which the trader's valuation is revealed only if no transaction occurs. Assuming that trader valuations are drawn i.i.d. from an unknown distribution while market prices are chosen adversarially, they establish an expected regret bound of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{2/3})$. In this work, we improve upon this guarantee by establishing a high-probability regret bound of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T})$. As a warm-up, we first consider the full-feedback setting. We introduce a discretization of the bid-ask space based on two coupled grids and combine it with Hedge to achieve the desired regret rate. Building on these ideas, we then address the substantially weaker feedback induced by a limit order book and develop an algorithm that achieves the same guarantee. Finally, we investigate the limits of learnability in fully adversarial environments, where the valuations may vary arbitrarily as well. Perhaps surprisingly, we show that when both market prices and trader valuations are chosen adversarially, sublinear regret is impossible even under full feedback, thereby motivating our stochastic assumption on the valuations.

</details>


### [359] [Minimizing Cumulative Envy in Allocating a Sequence of Items](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09843)
*Paul W. Goldberg,Isaac Robinson,Nicholas Teh*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究不可分割物品顺序到达的时序公平分配，提出累积最大嫉妒指标，分析其复杂度并给出算法与近似保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统在线公平分配模型常假设未来信息未知，本文转而假设估值与未来到达已知，关注不公平性在时间维度上的累积演化，提出累积最大嫉妒以同时刻画嫉妒的强度与持续时间。

Method: 定义累积最大嫉妒（各轮最大两两嫉妒之和，即最坏嫉妒曲线下面积）。针对固定到达顺序，证明决策问题强NP完全且一般情形下无常数因子近似；给出常数代理人数的伪多项式动态规划、受限情形的多项式算法及相同整数估值下固定n的FPTAS。进一步研究可选择到达顺序的排序变体并设计贪心算法。

Result: 固定顺序下：强NP完全，即使相同或二元估值也无常数因子近似；常数n有伪多项式DP，受限情形多项式可解，固定n相同整数估值有FPTAS。排序变体：两代理人相同估值仍NP完全；贪心算法对n=2达3/2近似，任意n达n/(n-1)近似，并有依赖最大物品值的加性保证。

Conclusion: 累积最大嫉妒刻画了时序分配中不公平的强度与持续性；该问题计算上困难但通过动态规划、FPTAS及贪心近似在特定条件下可有效求解，且选择到达顺序可显著改善公平性。

Abstract: We study temporal fair division with indivisible goods that arrive sequentially and must be allocated irrevocably. In contrast to the usual online model, we assume that valuations and future arrivals are known in advance, and ask how unfairness evolves during the process. We introduce \emph{cumulative maximum envy}: the sum, over all rounds, of the maximum pairwise envy at that round. Equivalently, this is the area under the worst-envy curve, and it captures both the magnitude and the duration of envy. For a fixed arrival order, we show that the corresponding decision problem is strongly NP-complete and that minimizing this objective admits no constant-factor approximation unless P = NP, even under identical valuations and even under binary valuations. We complement these hardness results with a dynamic program that gives pseudopolynomial-time solvability for a constant number of agents, polynomial-time algorithms in further restricted settings, and an FPTAS for fixed $n$ under identical integer valuations. We then study a sequencing variant where the algorithm may choose the arrival order. This variant remains NP-complete even for two agents with identical valuations; however, a simple greedy algorithm achieves a $3/2$-approximation for $n=2$ agents, an $n/(n-1)$-approximation for any number of agents, and an additive guarantee depending on the maximum value of any good.

</details>


### [360] [Marrying Pricing and Advertising with LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09985)
*Alessandro Barro,Francesco Bacchiocchi,Francesco Emanuele Stradi,Alberto Marchesi*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究卖方联合发布价格与LLM生成广告的序贯定价问题，提出在线actor-critic算法（LoRA微调LLM+需求模型）以最大化未知需求下的收益，并在合成与真实市场模拟中取得显著收益提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 产品需求同时依赖价格与广告内容，但二者此前多被分开优化；卖方又仅能观测到是否成交，需求未知，因此需要一个能在线联合优化价格与LLM生成广告、且仅依赖购买反馈的方法。

Method: 提出在线actor-critic算法：actor基于预训练LLM的LoRA进行广告生成，critic用数据拟合需求模型估计购买概率以指导定价；每轮反馈同时更新actor与critic，并用critic的收益估计作为策略梯度的基线。

Result: 构建含三个合成需求模型与一个基于真实市场数据的模拟器的评估框架；相较非联合优化的基准，在三个合成模型上分别取得5.69%、5.18%、55.96%的期望收益提升，在市场模拟器上提升5.81%。

Conclusion: 联合优化LLM广告生成与价格选择能有效提升收益，在线actor-critic结合LoRA在仅观测购买反馈的条件下可行且有效。

Abstract: We study a sequential pricing problem in which a seller jointly posts a price and an advertisement generated by a large language model (LLM). The seller aims to maximize revenue under an unknown product demand that depends on both decisions, while observing only whether each offer leads to a purchase. We propose an online actor-critic algorithm that combines low-rank adaptation (LoRA) of a pretrained LLM with a demand model fitted to available data. At each round, the actor generates an advertisement, and the critic estimates purchase probabilities to guide price selection. Then, the resulting feedback is used to update both the actor and the critic, with the critic's revenue estimates providing a baseline for policy gradient updates of the actor. To evaluate our approach, we develop an evaluation framework with three synthetic demand models and a demand simulator built from real-world marketplace data. Finally, we compare our algorithm with benchmarks that do not jointly optimize price selection and advertisement generation, achieving expected revenue gains over the reference policy of 5.69%, 5.18% and 55.96% under the three synthetic demand models and 5.81% under the marketplace simulator.

</details>


### [361] [Asymptotic Subsidies for Envy-Free Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10272)
*Zekai Wu*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究将 m_n 个不可分物品分给 n 个代理时，实现精确无嫉妒所需的最小货币补贴，给出统一渐近刻画及多项式时间算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索不可分物品分配中精确无嫉妒性（exact envy-freeness）所需最小货币补贴的渐近行为，填补不同物品数量与代理数量关系下的理论空白。

Method: 假设估值加性、物品价值 i.i.d. 且密度有界；考虑 n→∞、m_n=qn+r_n。对非零余数情形，基于均衡捆最大权匹配与互补对偶价格设计三次时间算法；对 q=1 平方情形，用最大权完美匹配与全对最短路径求受限最优。

Result: 非零余数下算法总能返回无嫉妒结果；q≥1 时补贴与无限制最小均为 n-r_n+o_p(n)，q=0 且 r_n/n 收敛小于 1 时误差为 O_p(1)。r_n=0、q≥2 时高概率零补贴；q=1 时最小补贴为 Θ_p(log n)，且高概率等于每人恰得一件物品的受限最优。

Conclusion: 这些结果共同给出最小补贴的统一渐近刻画，并提供了相应的高效算法。

Abstract: We study the minimum monetary subsidy required for exact envy-freeness in allocating $m_n$ indivisible goods to $n$ agents. Valuations are additive, item values are i.i.d. from a distribution on $[0,1]$ with density bounded above and away from zero, and all agents value money equally. We consider $n\to\infty$ with $m_n=qn+r_n$, where $q\ge0$ is a fixed integer and $0\le r_n<n$. For the nonzero-remainder case where $1\le r_n<n$, we give a cubic-time algorithm based on a maximum-weight matching of balanced bundles and complementary dual prices. It returns an envy-free outcome for every instance. Under the random model, both its payment and the unrestricted minimum are $n-r_n+o_p(n)$ for $q\ge1$. When $q=0$ and $r_n/n$ converges to a limit below one, the error term improves to $O_p(1)$. For exact divisibility, where $r_n=0$, prior work gives zero subsidy with high probability for $q\ge2$. The square case $q=1$ is exceptional. Its minimum subsidy is $Θ_p(\log n)$ and, with high probability, equals the optimum over allocations in which every agent receives exactly one good. This restricted optimum can be computed in cubic time using a maximum-weight perfect matching and all-pairs shortest paths. Together, these results provide a unified asymptotic characterization of the minimum subsidy.

</details>


### [362] [Sharper bounds on the thresholds for sensitive and Blackwell optimality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10295)
*Xavier Allamigeon,Stéphane Gaubert,Julien Grand-Clément,Ricardo Katz*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文为完美信息双人随机博弈中的Blackwell最优与d-敏感最优阈值给出了更精细且紧的上下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典mean-payoff与折扣最优需推广以刻画更远见偏好，但已有对Blackwell阈值α_bw和d-敏感阈值α_d的界不够紧。

Method: 聚焦"约简"多项式族，结合Mahler与Cauchy界的经典根分离技术，控制最小多项式的次数与高度。

Result: 将约简族用于根分离，得到文献中最强的α_bw上下界，并首次在多链随机博弈中获得α_d的界。

Conclusion: 所提界在次数与高度控制意义下是紧的，既改进先前工作也扩展到d-敏感情形。

Abstract: In perfect-information two-player stochastic games, the notions of Blackwell and sensitive optimality provide generalizations of the classical mean-payoff optimality and discount optimality criteria to account for more farsighted preferences. We provide bounds on the Blackwell threshold $α_{\sf bw}$ and the $d$-sensitive thresholds $α_{\sf d}$, defined as the smallest discount factors above which discount optimal policies coincide with Blackwell optimal policies and $d$-sensitive optimal policies respectively. Our refined bounds improve upon prior work by focusing on ``reduced'' families of polynomials and, crucially, our bounds are tight in terms of controlling the degrees and heights of the minimal polynomials of the Blackwell thresholds. We apply classical root separation based on Mahler's and Cauchy's bounds to our reduced families to derive the strongest upper and lower bounds on $α_{\sf bw}$ in the literature, and we are the first to obtain bounds on $α_{\sf d}$ in the multichain stochastic setting.

</details>


### [363] [The Economic Security of Exponential EIP-1559](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10333)
*Ben Berger,Edward W. Felten,Robin Fritsch*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该论文研究区块链gas定价机制EIP-1559的参数选择问题，目标是在任意时间窗口内使用量超过阈值时保证收取的gas费总额有下界（经济安全），并将该方法应用于Ethereum使用的纯指数版本以及Robinhood Chain与Arbitrum采用的变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EIP-1559是广泛使用的区块链gas定价机制，其参数选择直接关系到长期目标（如限制状态增长）。既有工作未能在使用量超阈值时提供gas费收入的保证，因此需要实现"经济安全"：通过参数设定使超过特定使用水平时的费用下界足够高，从而经济上抑制过度使用。

Method: 作者针对纯指数版EIP-1559刻画了使收入最小化的gas使用分布；对于另一变体，构造了一个其对应费用收入可证明逼近最小值的分布。基于这些结果，给出为两种变体设定经济安全机制参数的方法，并讨论相关权衡。

Result: 提出了使收入最小化的gas使用分布（指数版本）及可证明逼近最小收入的构造分布（另一变体），并据此给出两种机制下经济安全参数的具体设定方式及权衡分析。

Conclusion: 该工作为EIP-1559及其变体提供了经济安全的参数选择框架，可用于长期目标（如限制状态增长），并明确了设定参数时的取舍。

Abstract: We consider the problem of parameter selection for EIP-1559, a widely used gas pricing mechanism for blockchains. As opposed to previous work, we aim to achieve economic security, where the chosen parameters guarantee a lower bound on total collected gas fees whenever usage over a given time window exceeds a specified threshold. This bound can be set prohibitively high, thereby economically deterring usage above a desired level. Such guarantees are particularly relevant to long-term objectives such as limiting state growth.
  We apply our approach to the pure exponential version of EIP-1559 which Ethereum uses and to a variant used by Robinhood Chain and Arbitrum. To achieve economic security, we first characterize the revenue-minimizing gas-usage distribution for the exponential version and for the other variant we construct a distribution whose associated fee revenue provably approximates the minimum.
  Using these results, we then demonstrate how to set economically secure mechanism parameters for both variants and we discuss the associated tradeoffs.

</details>


### [364] [Settling PROPm and PROPavg in Graphical Resource Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10336)
*Bo Li,Ankang Sun,Ruijie Wang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究了图资源分配中的比例公平性，证明了PROPm朝向在多图上对物品（goods）、杂务（chores）及混合情况总存在且可高效计算，而PROPavg朝向即使对简单图和二元估值也可能不存在且判定其存在性为NP完全。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图资源分配中，PROP1朝向总存在而PROPx朝向可能不存在，但中间松弛PROPm和PROPavg（无图约束时可满足）是否总能满足尚待解决，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 通过理论证明与分析，研究PROPm和PROPavg朝向的存在性；对PROPm给出高效计算算法并分析其效率损失（price of PROPm）；对PROPavg构造反例并证明NP完全性；进一步给出PROPm下福利优化及同时满足PROPm与Pareto最优的硬度结果。

Result: PROPm朝向在多图上对物品总存在且可高效计算，并扩展到杂务及混合情况；PROPavg朝向即使对简单图二元估值也可能不存在，其存在性判定为NP完全；对物品，price of PROPm恰为2；并得到PROPm下福利优化及同时PROPm与Pareto最优的硬度结果。

Conclusion: 本文完整解决了图资源分配中PROPm与PROPavg存在性的开放问题，表明PROPm是可行且高效的公平性保证，而PROPavg不可保证，并量化了PROPm的公平性代价。

Abstract: We study proportional fairness in graphical resource allocation, where agents are vertices, indivisible items are edges, and each item must be allocated to one of its two endpoints. It has been proved that PROP1 orientations always exist and PROPx orientations may not, but it has remained open whether the intermediate relaxations PROPm and PROPavg (both can be satisfied without graphical constraints) can always be satisfied. In this paper, we resolve this gap. We prove that PROPm orientations always exist for goods on multigraphs and can be computed efficiently. The guarantee extends to chores and a mixture of goods and chores. In sharp contrast, we show that PROPavg orientations need not exist, even for simple graphs with binary valuations, and that deciding their existence is NP-complete. We further quantify the efficiency loss of PROPm: for goods, the price of PROPm is exactly $2$, which is one of the few settings where a constant bound on the price of fairness can be obtained. We complement these results with hardness results for welfare optimization under PROPm and for the existence of orientations that are simultaneously PROPm and Pareto optimal.

</details>


### [365] [A Constant-Factor Approximation to Multidimensional Consumer Utility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10516)
*Kira Goldner,Taylor Lundy,Thodoris Tsilivis*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该论文研究多单位需求买家与异质物品下最大化消费者效用的机制，证明简单机制可达到最优效用的常数因子近似（一般独立值5.67+ε，i.i.d.情形<3.164）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受消费者以不可转让的"折磨"(ordeal)支付的社会服务启发，研究多单位需求买家、异质物品、独立先验分布下最大化消费者效用的机制。既有工作多近似社会福利，且最优效用与社会福利的差距是对数级，本文要回答简单机制能否保证对最优效用本身的常数因子近似。

Method: 机制让每个买家在"发布价格购买物品"或"免费物品彩票"之间选择最优选项，再用contention resolution决定哪些买家请求被满足。机制满足BIC、事后个体理性，且多项式时间可计算。核心技术贡献是给出最优事前约束效用的通用上界，将发布价格与免费彩票两类贡献分离。

Result: 一般独立值下达到(5.67+ε)-近似；i.i.d.值下改进至2e/(e-1)<3.164。建立了简单近最优机制理论在效用侧的对应结果。

Conclusion: 简单机制能以常数因子近似最优消费者效用本身（而非仅社会福利），为效用最大化提供了类似收入最优化的简单机制理论。

Abstract: Motivated by social services where consumers pay with non-transferable ordeals, we study mechanisms that maximize consumer utility for multiple unit-demand buyers and heterogeneous items whose values are drawn independently from known prior distributions. Prior work in utility maximization approximates social welfare and shows that the gap between optimal utility and social welfare is logarithmic. We resolve the question of whether simple mechanisms can guarantee a constant-factor approximation to optimal utility itself. Our mechanisms achieve a $(5.67+\varepsilon)$-approximation for general independent values, improving to $2e/(e-1)<3.164$ when values are i.i.d. Each buyer chooses their favorite option from posted item prices or free item lotteries, and contention resolution determines which buyers' requests are served; this is BIC, ex-post individually rational, and computable in polynomial time. Our main technical contribution is a general upper bound on the optimal ex-ante-constrained utility that separates the contributions captured by posted prices and free lotteries. These results establish a utility counterpart to the theory of simple, approximately revenue-optimal mechanisms.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [366] [A Bayesian Mirror Architecture for Emergent Consciousness: Circular Hierarchies, Self-Manifolds, and Hybrid Event-Self Binding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08792)
*Eduardo Righi Capanema de Almeida*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出贝叶斯镜像架构（BMA），一种自我指涉生成框架，通过闭环更新 S_t←H_{t-1} 使自我表征与世界模型耦合，并以最优传输几何（2-Wasserstein）刻画稳定、连贯与选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
