Abstract: We study learning optimal policies in average-reward multichain Markov decision processes (MDPs), where the optimal gain may depend on the initial state and recurrence structures vary across policies, creating challenges for reinforcement learning (RL) methods. We propose an asynchronous value-iteration-based RL algorithm that requires no model knowledge beyond the MDP's transition graph and leverages Bather's decomposition to hierarchically partition the state space into communicating subsystems and transient states. This decomposition induces a recasting of the global decision problem into structured subproblems, which our algorithm exploits. We show that the algorithm converges to the optimal gain and produces gain-optimal policies after finite time. Building on this base algorithm, we develop two further algorithms: one approximately solves the multichain average optimality equations to obtain near gain-optimal policies, and another targets near bias-optimality by approximating the optimal bias function and solving an induced average-reward multichain MDP using the base algorithm. We provide almost-sure convergence guarantees for all three algorithms and empirically compare their tradeoffs, showing that the latter two also consistently improve transient performance relative to the base algorithm. To our knowledge, these are the first essentially model-free average-reward RL algorithms for general multichain MDPs without reductions to discounted problems.

</details>


### [549] [AutoAdapt: Automatic Domain Discovery Enables Low-Cost Extensibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10349)
*Josh McGiff,Salma Mekaoui,Robert Shanahan,Nikola S. Nikolov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AutoAdapt 是一个模块化框架，能在不改动已有适配器的情况下，通过单适配器训练引入新领域和数据，实现免重训的领域特化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 指令微调模型需部署在异构且不断演化的领域环境中，但新增领域或数据通常需要昂贵的重训练，且多领域联合训练会导致领域间干扰。

Method: 自动发现潜在领域，基于发现结果并行独立地为每个领域训练 LoRA 适配器，并采用无参数路由机制整合各适配器。

Result: 在 14 个领域特定基准和 GPT-4o 成对评判中，AutoAdapt 达到了与在所有领域上训练的单 LoRA 适配器相当的性能，且无需全模型重训；同时发现不同独立发现方法间存在特化效应收敛的证据。

Conclusion: 每个适配器仅在其自身领域上训练，从构造上避免了领域干扰，从而实现模块化、免分类体系的领域特化，且不损失总体性能、无需全模型重训。

Abstract: Instruction-tuned models are deployed into environments where domains are heterogeneous and evolve, yet adding new domains or data typically requires costly retraining. We present AutoAdapt, a modular framework that incorporates new domains and data via targeted single-adapter training without modifying other adapters. The framework automatically discovers latent domains, uses them to train per-domain Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapters independently in parallel and performs parameter-free routing. Across 14 domain-specific benchmarks and GPT-4o pairwise judgements, AutoAdapt achieves parity with a LoRA adapter trained on all domains without requiring full-model retraining. We also find evidence of specialisation effect convergence across independent discovery methods. Overall, training each adapter on its own domain prevents domain interference by construction, thus enabling modular, taxonomy-free domain specialisation without aggregate performance loss or full model retraining.

</details>


### [550] [ORDERS: An Empirical Study of Norm-Rank Aggregation for Personalized Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10361)
*Koffka Khan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究个性化联邦学习配置ORDERS，发现其服务器加权规则在充分指定的评估下贡献有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化联邦学习结合共享表示与客户端特定预测器，但服务器加权规则的真实贡献常被本地训练与评估选择掩盖，需要严格评估。

Method: ORDERS配置共享主干、私有残差适配器与分类器、按更新范数降序的几何权重、特征对齐及私有参数扰动。评估含80次最终运行：8种配置、2个数据集、每数据集固定划分上的5个训练种子。

Result: CIFAR-10上ORDERS达80.51±0.79%，FedPer-R1为79.02±1.42%，匹配均匀权重对照为80.27±0.73%；共同本地微调后与FedPer-R1差距缩至0.32个百分点。Sent140上ORDERS达74.71±0.49%，仅比事后多数类诊断高0.69点。消融对范数排序与对齐证据有限且依赖端点，扰动无明确收益；参数节省分别为5.47%和0.78%。

Conclusion: 服务器加权规则未带来额外优化效果，ORDERS优势微弱且部分源于评估选择，其设计组件证据不足。

Abstract: Personalized federated learning combines shared representations with client-specific predictors, but the contribution of a server weighting rule can be obscured by local training and evaluation choices. We study ORDERS, a configuration that combines a shared backbone, a private residual adapter and classifier, geometric weights assigned by descending update norm, feature alignment, and private-parameter perturbations. The server computes a weighted sum of updates obtained from the same broadcast model; it does not obtain an additional optimization effect from sequential addition. A fully specified evaluation comprises 80 final runs: eight configurations, two datasets, and five training seeds on one fixed partition per dataset. On two-class-per-client CIFAR-10, ORDERS achieves $80.51 \pm 0.79\%$ native mean client accuracy, compared with $79.02 \pm 1.42\%$ for FedPer-R1 and $80.27 \pm 0.73\%$ for the matched uniform-weight control. After common local fine-tuning, the difference from FedPer-R1 narrows to 0.32 percentage points. On Sent140, ORDERS reaches $74.71 \pm 0.49\%$, only 0.69 points above a post hoc client training-majority diagnostic. Ablations provide limited, endpoint-dependent evidence for norm ranking and alignment, and no clear benefit from perturbations. Parameter-payload savings are 5.47% and 0.78%, respectively.

</details>


### [551] [Koopman Observers for Diffusion Acceleration: Correcting Feature Forecasts with Shallow Measurements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10366)
*Hanru Bai,Yuanchao Xu,Fengyi Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出观测校正的Koopman框架，用新鲜计算浅层特征作为观测来修正深层特征预测，加速冻结扩散模型采样，在保持无需重训练的前提下显著降低特征MSE并实现约1.9倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 特征缓存加速扩散采样虽用历史激活预测替代昂贵网络评估，但仅依赖过去特征无法纳入当前去噪状态的变化。本文探究能否用廉价、新计算的浅层特征作为观测来校正这些预测。

Method: 基于校准轨迹识别有限维、时变的Koopman近似，联合描述浅层与深层网络特征的增量。加速采样时用该算子预测深层特征演化，并以观测到的浅层特征创新来校正预测状态；周期性全评估刷新观测器，且所有生成模型参数保持不变。该框架支持对时间预测与观测校正进行受控比较。

Result: 每个数据集进行三次10,000张图像运行。相比同四部分步调度下的通道仿射预测，方法将配对Inception特征MSE在CIFAR-10降低19.9%、在十类ImageNet子集降低11.9%；匹配消融显示观测校正额外贡献4.54%和4.67%的降低。观测器相对DDIM-50实现1.89倍和1.85倍实测加速。

Conclusion: 该方法在无需重训练去噪器的情况下提升了参考采样器保真度，验证了用新鲜浅层特征进行观测校正对加速扩散采样的有效性。

Abstract: Feature caching accelerates diffusion sampling by replacing expensive network evaluations with predictions from previously computed activations. However, forecasts based only on past features cannot directly incorporate changes in the current denoising state. We investigate whether inexpensive, freshly computed features can serve as observations for correcting these predictions. We introduce an observation-corrected Koopman framework for accelerating frozen diffusion models. Using calibration trajectories, we identify finite-dimensional, time-dependent Koopman approximations that jointly describe the increments of shallow and deep network features. During accelerated sampling, these operators predict the evolution of expensive deep features, while innovations in the observed shallow features correct the predicted state. Periodic full evaluations refresh the observer, and all generative-model parameters remain unchanged. This formulation enables controlled comparisons of temporal prediction and observation correction. Across three 10,000-image runs per dataset, our method reduces paired Inception-feature MSE by $19.9\%$ on CIFAR-10 and $11.9\%$ on a ten-class ImageNet subset relative to channelwise affine prediction under the same four-partial-step schedule. Matched ablations attribute additional reductions of $4.54\%$ and $4.67\%$ to observation correction. The observer achieves $1.89\times$ and $1.85\times$ measured speedups over DDIM-50, supporting improved reference-sampler fidelity without retraining the denoiser.

</details>


### [552] [Temporally Interpretable Differentiable Decision Trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10367)
*Eisuke Hirota,Aarav Sane,Rohan Paleja*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"时间可解释性"概念，通过动作分块将可微决策树(DDT)扩展到多时间步决策，使其更适合序列决策任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可微决策树(DDT)虽提供透明性，但存在树单时间步行为与人类多时间步规划之间的固有错配，不适合序列决策任务。

Method: 引入时间作为可解释性新维度；提出两种含动作分块的新型策略梯度算法；开发基于信息论的树重构算法以在训练中维持参数高效性；采用从蒸馏的动作分块策略热启动DDT。

Result: 在四个仿真环境中，从蒸馏的动作分块策略热启动的DDT最有效：在其中三个环境中达到与神经网络策略相当的性能，且参数减少最多80%。

Conclusion: 动作分块与热启动结合能获得时间可解释的决策树，兼顾可解释性、性能与参数效率。代码已开源。

Abstract: Interpretability offers a solution to safe autonomy by providing transparency into an agent's underlying decision-making model. Within sequential-decision making tasks, differentiable decision trees (DDTs) are one approach to such interpretability, maintaining automatic-differentiable policies while providing humans with a discrete tree-based visualization. Nonetheless, current implementations of DDTs are not well-suited for sequential-decision making domains, as there exists an inherent mismatch between a tree's single-timestep behavior and a human's multi-timestep planning. Our work thus introduces time as a new dimension of interpretability, coined as temporal interpretability, and demonstrates how temporal abstractions via action chunking improve it. We achieve this by first introducing two novel policy gradient algorithms that incorporate action chunking. Additionally, to maintain parameter-efficient trees, we develop an information-theoretic tree restructuring algorithm that modifies the tree during training. Across four simulation environments, we find that warm-starting action chunked DDTs from a distilled action chunked policy is the most effective way to obtain temporally interpretable trees: they match neural network policies in three of the four domains while using up to 80$\%$ fewer parameters. Our code is available at https://github.com/ei5uke/temp-interp.

</details>


### [553] [Continual Learning without Continual Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10379)
*Nikita Narayanan,Ritham Majumdarr,Sonali Parbhoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出将连续学习从"连续训练"转为"连续推理"：基于PFN元训练后冻结参数，仅靠扩展in-context证据集适应新类别/域，减少遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有连续学习方法依赖持续优化（正则化、重放、参数扩展）来防止新更新覆盖旧知识，但难以避免遗忘，且通常无法同时处理域增量和类增量任务。

Method: Latent Concept PFN模型在语义共享的潜概念空间上做in-context贝叶斯推理；新域/类到来时仅向记忆添加样本，通过更新潜概念后验实现适应，无需梯度更新。概念标注仅用于元训练，作为潜空间的软锚点而非固定瓶颈，并结合原始输入证据处理噪声、模糊或不完整标注。

Result: 在类增量和域增量学习数据集上取得有竞争力的连续学习性能，同时学到可解释的潜概念。

Conclusion: 连续推理替代连续训练可有效减轻遗忘，统一处理无需任务标识的域与类增量学习，并提供可解释性。

Abstract: Continual learning requires models to adapt to new domains and new classes while retaining prior knowledge. Many existing methods rely on continued optimization, using regularization, replay, or parameter expansion to prevent new updates from overwriting previously learned knowledge. Instead, we propose replacing continual training with continual inference: a PFN-based model that is meta-trained, and then frozen, adapting to new classes only by extending an in-context evidence set. Our model, Latent Concept PFN, performs in-context Bayesian inference over a latent concept space that captures semantic structure shared across domains and classes. As each new domain or class arrives, exemplars are added to the memory; adaptation reflects updated posterior beliefs over latent concepts rather than gradient updates. No parameters are changed, reducing forgetting. The same method handles both domain and class incremental continual learning without task identity. Concept annotations are only used during meta-training, acting as a soft anchor on the latent space rather than a fixed bottleneck. Unlike fixed-vocabulary concept methods, the model also handles noisy, ambiguous, or incomplete annotations by combining concept labels with raw input evidence to discover distinctions beyond the predefined concept set. Experiments on class and domain incremental learning datasets demonstrate competitive continual learning performance while learning interpretable latent concepts.

</details>


### [554] [ResidualQuant: KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers with 2-Bit Residuals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10381)
*Heejun Kim,Junyoung Lee,SangLyul Cho,Dongsu Han,Insu Han,Sehoon Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ResidualQuant，利用循环Transformer跨循环KV高度相似的特性，用末循环KV作参考、其余循环用低精度残差表示，实现INT2精度量化，大幅降低KV显存并提升吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环Transformer通过复用共享块提升参数效率，但KV cache随循环次数线性增长，成为显存瓶颈，限制批大小与推理吞吐。现有KV量化方法在极低精度下精度损失严重。

Method: 观察到跨循环KV状态高度相似，提出ResidualQuant：以末循环KV为参考，对剩余循环用低精度残差表示；结合最小二乘缩放、残差旋转及逐循环混合精度，实现INT2量化并保持高效重建。

Result: 在多个循环Transformer模型及数学推理、代码生成任务上，ResidualQuant优于现有旋转式KV量化。混合精度下精度接近BF16，KV存储理论降低80.7%；同显存预算下精度最高提升13.0%。RTX 5090上解码吞吐提升最高2.73x，批大小最大2x，峰值吞吐提升最高4.15x。

Conclusion: 利用循环Transformer的跨循环KV相似性做残差量化，可在极低精度下兼顾精度与显存效率，有效突破KV cache瓶颈，显著提升推理吞吐。

Abstract: Looped Transformers improve parameter efficiency by repeatedly applying shared Transformer blocks over multiple recurrent loops, increasing computational depth without increasing the parameter count. However, KV cache memory still scales with the number of loops, becoming a key memory bottleneck that limits batch size and inference throughput. KV cache quantization can alleviate this bottleneck, but existing methods often suffer substantial accuracy degradation at aggressive low-precision regimes. We observe that looped Transformers offer a unique opportunity: KV states across loops are highly similar. Based on this observation, we propose ResidualQuant, which uses the final-loop KV states as a reference and represents the remaining loops with low-precision residuals. Our method further combines least-square scaling and rotations applied to the residuals, as well as loop-wise mixed precision, to enable accurate quantization down to INT2 while retaining efficient reconstruction. Across multiple looped Transformer models and mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, ResidualQuant consistently improves the accuracy-memory tradeoff over state-of-the-art rotation-based KV quantization. In particular, our method retains accuracy close to BF16 under mixed-precision settings while reducing theoretical KV storage by 80.7%, achieving up to 13.0% higher accuracy than the rotation-based baseline at the same memory budget. On an RTX 5090, the reduced KV memory traffic improves fixed-batch decode throughput by up to 2.73x, while the smaller memory footprint enables up to 2x larger batches, improving peak throughput by up to 4.15x.

</details>


### [555] [Boosting and the Expressive Power of Simple Weak Learners via the $γ$-VC Dimension](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10383)
*Arthur da Cunha,Kasper Green Larsen,Liang-Yu Zou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究Boosting中基类结构对分类器表达力的影响，通过γ-VC维刻画弱到强学习的样本复杂度，并锐化VC维与γ-VC维关系，给出决策树桩和轴平行矩形的改进上下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Boosting能将弱假设转化为高精度预测器，但最终分类器的表达力强烈依赖基类结构，需要理论刻画这一现象。

Method: 使用Alon等人（STOC 2021）提出的γ-VC维作为分析工具，研究其在弱到强学习中的作用。

Result: 证明γ-VC维可刻画弱到强学习的样本复杂度（相差γ的常数因子）；锐化了经典VC维与γ-VC维的一般关系；对决策树桩和R^d中轴平行矩形给出改进的γ-VC维上下界。

Conclusion: γ-VC维是理解Boosting表达力与样本复杂度的关键参数，并在基本概念类上得到更精确的界。

Abstract: Boosting converts weak hypotheses with a small edge over random guessing into highly accurate predictors, but the expressive power of the resulting classifier can depend strongly on the structure of the base class. We study this phenomenon through the $γ$-VC dimension introduced by Alon et al. (STOC 2021). Our first result shows that this parameter characterizes the sample complexity for weak-to-strong learning up to a constant factor scaling in $γ$. We then sharpen the general relationship between the classic VC dimension and the $γ$-VC dimension. Finally, we also give improved upper and lower bounds on the $γ$-VC dimension for the fundamental concept classes of decision stumps and axis-parallel rectangles in $\mathbb{R}^d$.

</details>


### [556] [OrBIT: Structure-Guided Embedding Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10385)
*Yunied Puig,Amit Kumar Jaiswal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OrBIT是一个结构引导的嵌入压缩框架，通过从轨道动力学中学习可复用的局部几何来约束共享码字，在四个LLM嵌入表上实现高达37.9倍压缩，同时保持竞争力的率失真性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代语言模型的嵌入表是最大组件之一。现有压缩方法通常固定编码几何（坐标块、低秩子空间或自由码本）并在此框架内优化，缺乏对编码几何本身的探索。

Method: 提出OrBIT框架：从轨道动力学学习可复用的局部几何，约束一小组共享码字；利用全局重建残差决定固定编码预算的分配；通过冗余重叠的图表让局部误差在粘合后互相补偿。理论分析了紧图表几何对失真的控制、全局残差引导的顺序分配以及数据几何引导的细化。轨道机制最终被编译消除，留下紧凑解码器。

Result: 在四个LLM嵌入表上，相对16位存储，GPT-2实现37.9倍压缩，每个7B表实现超过23倍压缩，率失真性能与主流量化和低秩基线相当。

Conclusion: 编码几何可以被自动发现而非固定，学习到的结构能有效控制存储内容、容量分配和局部信息的全局组装，实现高压缩率且性能有竞争力。

Abstract: Embedding tables are among the largest components of modern language models. Most compression methods fix a coding geometry such as coordinate blocks, low-rank subspaces, or unrestricted codebooks, and optimize within it. We instead ask whether the coding geometry can itself be discovered. We introduce \emph{OrBIT}, a structure-guided embedding compression framework that learns reusable local geometry from orbit dynamics and uses it to constrain a small set of shared codewords. The global reconstruction residual then decides where the fixed coding budget is spent, while redundant overlapping charts let local errors compensate one another after gluing. Our theory shows how tight-chart geometry controls distortion, how the global residual directs sequential allocation, and how data-geometry-guided refinement improves the codec. The resulting orbit machinery is compiled away, leaving a compact decoder in which the learned structure governs what is stored, where capacity is allocated, and how local information is assembled globally. Across four LLM embedding tables, OrBIT achieves $37.9\times$ compression on GPT-2 and over $23\times$ on each 7B table relative to 16-bit storage, while delivering competitive rate-distortion performance against established quantization and low-rank baselines.

</details>


### [557] [Kernel Autoresearch for Open-Ended Model Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10394)
*Richard Cornelius Suwandi,Feng Yin,Kevin Murphy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Kernaut，将核设计视为开放式模型发现，用编码智能体编写核程序，通过构造契约保证有效性，并用质量-多样性存档和新颖性筛选发现可复用、可泛化的核。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动核设计面临两难：固定语法保证有效性但限制搜索空间；无限制程序可自由搜索却不能保证有效性。且LLM生成的核在随机输入上通过数值检查，却在不同尺度/维度下失效（22-58%）。

Method: Kernaut：编码智能体将核写成程序；构造契约(contracts)确保每个被接受的核有效；质量-多样性存档保留高性能且行为不同的核；新颖性筛选引导智能体寻找功能上新的候选。

Result: 发现的核编码可复用的归纳偏置并泛化到未见任务：在留出黑箱优化族上超过同数据元学习的深度核；从十个酶动力学速率定律发现的核在五个未见过机制上误差低于调优ARD和深度核基线。人类可进一步精炼，精炼版降低5.7%预测误差、7.8%优化遗憾。

Conclusion: Kernaut表明核设计可作为开放式发现任务，兼顾有效性与搜索自由，发现的核既有效、可解释，又能泛化并被人类精炼改进。

Abstract: Kernels encode the inductive bias of a wide range of machine learning models, yet automated kernel design faces a fundamental dilemma. A fixed grammar of base kernels and operators guarantees validity but limits the search to structures expressible by those building blocks. Conversely, unrestricted programs remove this limitation but no longer guarantee validity. In our stress tests, 22-58% of LLM-generated kernels that pass numerical checks on random inputs fail when evaluated at different scales or dimensions. We propose Kernel Autoresearch (Kernaut), which treats kernel design as open-ended model discovery. Coding agents write kernels as programs, while construction contracts ensure that every accepted kernel is valid. A quality-diversity archive retains high-performing kernels with distinct behaviors, and novelty screening steers agents toward functionally new candidates. Our experiments demonstrate that the discovered kernels encode reusable inductive biases that generalize to unseen tasks. On held-out black-box optimization families, a discovered kernel outperforms a meta-learned deep kernel trained on the same episodes. Furthermore, kernels discovered from ten enzyme-kinetic rate laws achieve lower error than tuned ARD and deep kernel baselines on five unseen mechanisms. The discovered kernels are also interpretable programs that human researchers can refine: a human-refined version of one further reduces the held-out predictive error by 5.7% and optimization regret by 7.8%.

</details>


### [558] [Executing Causal Structure Learning with Linear-Attention Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10395)
*Amartya Roy,Sayar Karmakar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究Transformer能否执行因果发现算法，构造了一个固定权重Transformer精确复现连续因果发现方法的一次更新，并分析了精确执行与因果恢复的区别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer已能执行输入数据上的算法，但能否用于因果发现尚不明确。作者希望探究Transformer是否可以精确执行标准连续因果发现方法的优化轨迹。

Method: 作者显式构造一个固定权重Transformer，其前向传播精确复现连续因果发现方法（反复更新候选因果图并强制无环）的单次更新，重复块即可复现优化轨迹。Transformer在更新间携带当前图与算法乘子。作者还给出条件，使固定阶段内达到目标精度所需更新次数可预先计算，且随深度增加舍入误差保持有界。

Result: 实验显示构造块与参考更新在浮点精度内一致；在合成数据和七个公开基准网络拓扑上的算术回放继承了参考求解器的成功与失败。普通注意力模型在训练预算下无法可靠执行更新或迁移到更大图。

Conclusion: 该工作将精确算法执行与准确因果恢复分开，证明构造的Transformer能精确执行更新，但普通注意力模型难以做到；梯度训练能否在该架构类中学到执行器仍待研究。

Abstract: Transformers can execute algorithms on data given in their input. We ask whether they can do the same for causal discovery. We study a standard continuous method that repeatedly updates a candidate causal graph while enforcing acyclicity. We explicitly construct a fixed-weight transformer whose forward pass exactly reproduces one update of this method, so repeated blocks reproduce its optimization trajectory. The transformer carries the current graph and the algorithm's multiplier between updates. We show that retaining the multiplier is essential for exact execution, since different multiplier values can lead to different next updates. We also give conditions under which, within a fixed stage, the number of updates needed to reach a target accuracy can be computed in advance and rounding errors stay bounded as depth grows. Experiments show that the constructed block agrees with a reference update to floating-point precision, while arithmetic replay on synthetic data and seven published benchmark network topologies inherits the reference solver's successes and failures. This separates accurate algorithm execution from accurate causal recovery. In contrast, the ordinary attention models tested under our training budgets do not reliably execute the update or transfer to larger graphs. Whether gradient training can learn an executor in the architecture class of the construction remains open.

</details>


### [559] [Cross-Domain Pretraining for Steady-State Neural CFD Surrogates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10398)
*Anthony Zhou,Amir Barati Farimani,Shirley Ho,Rudy Morel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究跨域预训练对CFD神经代理模型的泛化能力提升，发现跨几何、边界条件和精度的预训练可显著改善零样本和少样本性能，且该收益与模型架构无关，随模型规模和预训练数据多样性增加而提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CFD神经代理模型的主要局限在于对训练集之外的几何形状和应用缺乏泛化能力。当前解决方案需要针对特定应用生成新数据集，但需运行昂贵的数值求解器。作者希望探索能否通过跨域预训练来缓解这一问题。

Method: 研究在不同几何形状、边界条件和精度上训练的神经代理模型。比较跨域预训练、从头训练和从领域专家模型迁移三种策略。分析跨域预训练在CFD代理中有效的原因，并测试简单地合并稳态数据集的效果。

Result: 跨域预训练相比从头训练和领域专家迁移，在留出数据集上提升了零样本和少样本性能。微调预训练跨域模型可在相同样本量下达到2-3倍更低的误差，或用8倍更少的样本达到相同误差。该收益与架构无关，随模型规模和预训练数据多样性提升而增强。简单地合并稳态数据集既充分又有效。

Conclusion: 鉴于生成CFD数据成本高昂，通过跨域预训练利用现有数据集将成为未来代理模型拓展新问题和应用场景的重要策略。

Abstract: Neural surrogates for computational fluid dynamics (CFD) have the potential to greatly enhance engineering innovation through accelerating simulation. However, the primary limitation for neural surrogates is the lack of generalization to geometries and applications beyond the training set, which is significant given the diversity of engineering scenarios. Currently, this is addressed by generating a new dataset for a specific application; however, this requires running costly numerical solvers. In this work, we take a step toward addressing this by studying neural surrogates trained across different geometries, boundary conditions, and fidelities. We find that cross-domain pretraining improves zero- and few-shot performance on held-out datasets relative to both training from scratch and transferring from domain-specific experts. In particular, finetuning a pretrained, cross-domain model can achieve 2-3x lower errors at the same sample size and use 8x fewer samples to achieve the same error, compared to training from scratch. This benefit is architecture agnostic and improves with model size and pretraining dataset diversity. Furthermore, we study how and why cross-domain pretraining works in CFD surrogates, and find that simply pooling steady-state datasets is both sufficient and effective. Given the high cost of generating CFD data, leveraging existing datasets through cross-domain pretraining will likely be a valuable strategy as future surrogates expand to tackle new problems and use cases.

</details>


### [560] [Q-Learning with Scalar Adjoint Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10437)
*Yonghoon Dong,Minsung Yoon,Jaehyuk Kim,Jungwoo Park,Changyeon Kim,Jinwoo Shin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 SQAM，用标量伴随替换每步向量-雅可比积，结合价值惩罚，高效微调 flow 策略，显著提升最难的 OGBench 域与真实机器人任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Flow 策略能捕捉多样动作分布，用 off-policy RL 微调其超越演示已被广泛关注，但对学习到的价值函数微调 flow 策略并不简单，因为动作要在多个 flow 步骤中产生。伴随匹配可将价值信息从最终动作传回各步，但每步都需向量-雅可比积，成本随 flow 步数和策略规模增长。

Method: 观察到预训练 flow 策略的批次平均速度雅可比集中在对角线上，据此推导出闭式标量伴随：将最终动作的价值梯度按 flow 时间缩放，从而消除逐步 VJP。并发现标量伴随下控制策略生成动作处的 critic 价值尤为重要，因此提出 SQAM，将标量伴随与这些动作上的价值惩罚结合。

Result: SQAM 收益集中在四个最难的 OGBench 域，每个域成功率超最强基线 18 至 35 个百分点。在真实双臂机器人上微调视觉-语言-动作策略，SQAM 在三个任务上均优于监督微调。

Conclusion: 基于雅可比对角集中现象的标量伴随匹配，可作为高效免 VJP 的 flow 策略微调方法，兼具仿真显著增益与真实机器人泛化能力。

Abstract: Flow policies capture rich and diverse action distributions, and fine-tuning them with off-policy RL to improve beyond the demonstrations has drawn growing interest. However, fine-tuning a flow policy against a learned value function is not trivial, because the policy generates its action over many flow steps. Adjoint matching offers a principled way to update the flow model itself by propagating value information from the final action back to each flow step, but it requires a vector--Jacobian product through the policy at every step, a cost that grows with the number of flow steps and the policy size. We observe that the batch-averaged velocity Jacobian of pretrained flow policies concentrates on its diagonal. Motivated by this finding, we derive a closed-form scalar adjoint that scales the value gradient at the final action by the flow time, eliminating the per-step vector--Jacobian products. We further find that controlling the critic's value at policy-generated actions is particularly important under the scalar adjoint. Based on these findings, we propose Q-learning with Scalar Adjoint Matching (SQAM), which combines the scalar adjoint with a value penalty at those actions. SQAM's gains concentrate on the four hardest OGBench domains, where its success rate exceeds that of the strongest baseline in each domain by 18 to 35 percentage points. To test whether SQAM extends to large pretrained policies, we also fine-tune a vision-language-action policy on a real bimanual robot. SQAM improves over supervised fine-tuning on all three tasks.

</details>


### [561] [Seq-Flow: Efficient Probabilistic Forecasting with Self-Rollout Error Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10440)
*Yinan Huang,Shitij Govil,Bo Dai,Pan Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Seq-Flow条件流模型，将上一预测分布作为下一流的起点，配合self-rollout训练实现少步、高效的连续预测更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学预测需随新观测不断更新未来轨迹分布。传统扩散/流模型需从高斯噪声重新生成，采样步数多；warm-start方法虽复用旧预测，但模型本身未针对“预测更新”训练，少步采样质量差。

Method: Seq-Flow用一个条件流模型，其ODE将样本从上一预测分布输运到更新后的分布；因相邻预测差异小，从有信息分布出发可用极少流评估完成更新。针对递归复用导致的误差累积，采用self-rollout训练：用模型的滑动平均副本生成预测来初始化后续训练更新；与self-forcing复用生成输出作条件不同，Seq-Flow把生成结果作为下一流的源。

Result: 粒子加速器束流预测中，少NFE预算下CRPS降低65%；在流体动力学任务上与强基线相当。虽训练时最多self-rollout四次，推理可保持400+次连续更新的准确性。

Conclusion: Seq-Flow通过从上一预测分布出发的流输运与self-rollout训练，兼顾少步采样效率与长期更新精度，适用于连续科学预测。代码已开源。

Abstract: Many scientific forecasting tasks require updating a distribution over future trajectories as new observations arrive. Conventional diffusion and flow models generate each forecast from Gaussian noise, often at the cost of many sampling steps. Warm-start methods reuse earlier predictions to reduce this cost, but their models are not trained to perform the forecast update itself, which can compromise quality under few-step sampling. In this work, we introduce Seq-Flow, a conditional flow model whose ODE transports samples from the previous forecast distribution to the updated one. Because successive forecasts often differ only modestly, this transport starts from an informative distribution and can produce accurate updates with few flow evaluations. Recursive reuse also creates a challenge: errors in one forecast become errors in the initial states of subsequent flows. We address this with self-rollout training, in which a moving average copy of the model generates forecasts that initialize later training updates. Unlike self-forcing methods, which reuse generated outputs as conditioning context, Seq-Flow reuses them as the source of the next flow. Experiments On particle-accelerator beam spill forecasting show Seq-Flow reduces CRPS by 65% under a few-NFE sampling budget, while remaining competitive with strong baselines on fluid-dynamics forecasting tasks. Although trained on self-rollouts of at most four updates, Seq-Flow remains accurate over more than 400 consecutive updates. Our code is available at https://github.com/Graph-COM/Seq-Flow.

</details>


### [562] [A Good Self-Teacher Meets the Student Where They Are: Joint On-Policy Learning and Teaching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10447)
*Randy Ardywibowo,Arnav Dalal,Jiantao Jiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出JOLT，通过分析特权教师对学生更新的影响，推导出教师蒸馏更新为学生奖励梯度正倍数的充要条件，并据此设计结合结果奖励与token级KL正则的教师训练目标，联合训练同一策略担任特权教师与非特权学生，在数学推理、编程、工具使用等任务上提升训练效率与性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL从结果奖励中学习面临监督稀疏问题，尤其长时程任务成功轨迹稀少且昂贵。On-Policy Distillation提供密集token级监督，自蒸馏进一步免除独立教师模型。但仅靠特权条件化不能保证蒸馏更新真正改进学生——特权信息可能让教师走学生无法使用的捷径，导致监督与学生当前行为不匹配，甚至高性能教师也会带来性能退化。因此需要分析特权教师选择如何影响学生更新。

Method: 作者分析特权教师选择对学生更新的影响，推导出教师局部蒸馏更新为学生奖励梯度正倍数的充要条件，表明教师不仅要任务表现好，还要提供适合学生当前能力的指导。由此提出实用教师训练替代目标：结合结果奖励与面向学生的token级KL正则。基于此提出JOLT，联合训练单一策略的两个角色：使用KL正则目标训练的特权教师，以及使用密集on-policy蒸馏训练的非特权学生。

Result: 在数学推理、编程、工具使用和终端使用任务上，JOLT提升了训练效率和性能，并且加入学生奖励后还能获得进一步提升。

Conclusion: 仅靠特权条件化不能保证有效的自蒸馏；教师需提供匹配学生当前能力的指导。JOLT通过KL正则结果奖励联合训练教师与学生角色，在实践中显著提升训练效率与表现，并可与学生奖励结合获得额外收益。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) from outcome rewards suffers from sparse supervision, particularly on difficult, long-horizon tasks where successful trajectories are rare and costly to generate. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) offers an attractive alternative by providing dense token-level supervision from a stronger teacher along the student's own generations. Self-distillation methods further remove the need for a separate teacher model by conditioning the same policy on privileged information to serve as its own teacher. However, privileged conditioning alone does not guarantee that the resulting distillation update improves the student. Indeed, privileged information can lead the teacher to solve tasks through shortcuts unavailable to the student, producing supervision poorly matched to the student's current behavior. Consequently, even a higher-performing teacher can provide guidance that degrades student performance. To address this, we analyze how the choice of privileged teacher affects the student's update. We derive a necessary and sufficient condition for the teacher's local distillation update to be a positive multiple of the student's reward gradient. Our analysis suggests that the teacher should not only perform well on the task, but also provide guidance suited to the student's current capabilities. This characterization motivates a practical teacher-training surrogate that combines outcome rewards with token-level Kullback-Leibler (KL) regularization toward the student. Based on this result, we propose Joint On-Policy Learning and Teaching (JOLT), which jointly trains a single policy in two roles: a privileged teacher using a KL-regularized objective, and an unprivileged student using dense on-policy distillation. Across mathematical reasoning, coding, tool use, and terminal use, JOLT improves training efficiency and performance, with further gains from student rewards.

</details>


### [563] [NeuralBES: A Differentiable, Control-Aware Emulator for Scalable Building Energy Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10459)
*Ting-Yu Dai,Takuya Kurihana,Wing Yee Au,Hon Yung Wong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NeuralBES是一种可微的建筑能耗仿真器，用共享神经编码器参数化RC热模型，兼顾物理可解释性与数据驱动的可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具在保真度与可扩展性之间存在硬性权衡：EnergyPlus等物理仿真器准确但需逐栋校准且串行计算；纯数据驱动序列模型可扩展但丧失物理结构，导致预测不可信。

Method: 将建筑静态元数据（面积、年代、HVAC类型）经共享神经编码器映射为物理有界的电容、电导和设备系数，作为标量线性递推的系数，用对数空间并行扫描求解；用预测-校正循环处理恒温器-温度非线性，同时保持全时域梯度流。在ResStock数据集的三个气候区上训练。

Result: 全年滚动预测中，NeuralBES是唯一兼具物理有效性与准确性的数据条件模型，MAPE与最强原始误差基线相差4个点以内，参数约少一个数量级；在同参数量的物理有效基线中，其MAPE不到灰箱RC方案的一半。

Conclusion: NeuralBES通过将神经编码与RC物理结构结合，在一个编码器内处理异构建筑，解决了准确性与物理可信度的权衡。

Abstract: Demand-side flexibility i.e. forecasting, shifting, and curtailing residential energy loads, depends on thermal models trusted across millions of heterogeneous buildings. Existing tools force a hard tradeoff: high-fidelity physics simulators such as EnergyPlus are accurate but sequential and require per-building calibration, while purely data-driven sequence models scale but abandon the physical structure that makes their predictions trustworthy.
  We introduce NeuralBES (Building Energy Simulation), a differentiable emulator that resolves this tradeoff by parameterizing a resistance--capacitance (RC) based thermal model with a shared neural encoder: static building metadata such as floor area, vintage, and HVAC type is mapped to physically bounded capacitances, conductances, and equipment coefficients, which become the coefficients of a scalar linear recurrence solved via a log-space parallel scan, and a predictor--corrector loop closes the thermostat--temperature nonlinearity while preserving full-horizon gradient flow. Trained on the ResStock dataset across three climate zones, NeuralBES handles heterogeneous building archetypes, vintages, and climate zones within a single trained encoder, while black-box baselines produce statistically plausible but physically inconsistent trajectories. On the annual full-year rollout, NeuralBES is the only data-conditioned model that is simultaneously physics-valid and accurate to within 4 MAPE points of the strongest raw-error baseline, while operating at roughly an order of magnitude fewer parameters than the transformer and recurrent baselines; among physics-valid baselines at parameter parity it more than halves the MAPE of the grey-box RC alternative.

</details>


### [564] [Composing What Each Teacher Learned: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation through Teacher-Relative Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10460)
*Hejian Sang,Zhengze Zhou,Shayan Mohajer Hamidi,Xiaomin Li,Rohit Jain,Alborz Geramifard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Δ-MOPD：传递教师相对基座的logit偏移（重锚定在学生初始化上），而非端点策略，在多教师在线蒸馏中更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MOPD（共域组合与路由域蒸馏）通常传递教师的端点策略，混合了后训练改变与继承自基座的偏好，导致迁移受干扰。

Method: 用Δ-MOPD传递"教师减基座"的logit偏移，并重锚定在学生冻结初始化上；在固定教师选择下，与端点监督在两种设置中对比。

Result: 揭示阻碍端点迁移的机制：继承的基座拉力可超过后训练偏移；去除后降低教师项范数比与目标-学生KL。三教师组合超端点4.11 Math与1.95五分基准分；两教师持平。分阶段路由下均值更高，顺序差距从10.50降至6.42；交错路由下两者相当。

Conclusion: 目标构造是MOPD中独立于教师选择的设计维度；教师信号在同一状态组合时，偏移目标尤为有用，且益处可能延伸至跨训练阶段的信号累积。

Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) is used in two settings. In common-domain composition, several teachers score each student rollout from one prompt domain and their signals form a single target; in routed-domain distillation, prompts from different domains are assigned to the corresponding specialist. Both settings usually transfer each teacher's endpoint policy, which mixes what post-training changed with preferences inherited from the teacher's base. We introduce $Δ$-MOPD, which transfers each teacher's teacher-minus-base logit shift re-anchored at the student's frozen initialization, and compare it with endpoint supervision in both settings while holding teacher selection fixed. We first expose the mechanism that impedes endpoint transfer: inherited base pull can exceed the post-training shift. Removing it reduces the teacher-term norm ratio and target--student KL.
  Across our experiments, the results suggest that shift targets are particularly useful when teacher signals are combined at a state. With three composed teachers, $Δ$-MOPD exceeds endpoint composition by $4.11$ Math and $1.95$ five-benchmark points; with two, it matches endpoint accuracy. Under phased routing, it achieves higher mean performance in both phase orders and reduces the observed order gap from $10.50$ to $6.42$ points. Under interleaved routing, where each update involves one teacher, the two targets perform comparably. The phased results provide supporting evidence that the benefit may extend to signals accumulated across training phases. Target construction is thus an independent design axis in MOPD, complementary to teacher selection.

</details>


### [565] [Oracle-Efficient and Parameter-Free Agnostic Smoothed Online Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10499)
*Sasha Voitovych,Adam Block,Alexander Rakhlin,Abhishek Shetty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出首个在不可知（agnostic）设定下、无需知道基础测度μ的oracle-efficient平滑在线学习算法，基于Gaussian Follow-The-Perturbed-Leader，实现$\widetilde O(d\sqrt{T/\sigma})$的遗憾界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平滑在线学习介于全对抗与全随机之间，但现有oracle-efficient算法需假设能采样μ或标签被固定假设完美预测，限制了适用性。作者希望像ERM在不可知设定下那样，无需分布知识也能高效学习。

Method: 提出基于Gaussian Follow-The-Perturbed-Leader的算法，参数无关：不需要知道μ、平滑参数σ或时间跨度T；每轮仅需一次ERM oracle调用。

Result: 在VC维为d的二元类上达到$\widetilde O(d\sqrt{T/\sigma})$的遗憾，比最优仅差$\sqrt{d}$因子；同时证明了无需采样μ或完美标签假设。

Conclusion: 该工作首次去除了平滑在线学习中两个关键限制性假设，并引入若干可能独立有价值的新技术。

Abstract: Online learning is an attractive framework in many domains because it permits well-defined learning even when data are dependent or chosen adversarially. This generality, however, comes at a steep price, introducing significant statistical and computational barriers. Recently, smoothed online learning has emerged as a promising framework that interpolates between the fully adversarial and fully stochastic settings by assuming that the conditional law of each covariate has density at most $1/σ$ with respect to some fixed base measure $μ$, and it is known to match the statistical and computational guarantees of classical learning while still allowing for much of the flexibility of online learning. However, existing oracle-efficient algorithms require either (i) sampling access to the base measure $μ$ or (ii) labels that are perfectly predicted by a fixed hypothesis. Both assumptions limit the applicability of these algorithms, in contrast to statistical learning, where empirical risk minimization (ERM) learns efficiently in the agnostic setting without any knowledge of the data distribution. We show that neither assumption is necessary, giving the first oracle-efficient algorithm that achieves sublinear regret in the agnostic setting without knowledge of $μ$. Our algorithm, based on Gaussian Follow-The-Perturbed-Leader, is parameter-free: it requires no knowledge of $μ$, the smoothing parameter $σ$, or the horizon $T$, and it achieves regret $\widetilde O(d\sqrt{T/σ})$ for binary classes of VC dimension $d$ with a single call to an ERM oracle per round, which is optimal up to a $\sqrt{d}$ factor. En route to establishing the regret bound, we introduce several new techniques that may be of independent interest.

</details>


### [566] [Why Forget-Only Unlearning Needs Memorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10519)
*Luka Radić,Vikrant Singhal,Amartya Sanyal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究"仅遗忘"（forget-only）机器遗忘：算法只拿到已训练模型和待遗忘样本，无保留数据或额外训练信息。作者探讨其可行性，给出匹配重训练精度的下界，并分析成功遗忘所需记忆的信息量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器遗忘通常要求输出接近"从头重训（去除遗忘样本后）"的结果。但在现实中，遗忘算法往往只能访问已训练模型和待遗忘样本，没有保留数据。核心问题是：这种"仅遗忘"设定是否总能实现？

Method: 作者从理论角度分析：先构造"不同数据集产生相同模型但删除同样样本后需要不同输出"的情形，据此推导遗忘精度匹配重训练的下界，并对若干标准学习算法进行实例化；随后推导算法为应对任意删除请求必须记忆的训练数据信息量的下界，以简单阈值学习器为例进行分析。

Result: 1）仅遗忘是否可行取决于学习算法——不同数据集可能训练出相同模型，但删除同样样本后所需输出差异很大；2）据此给出匹配重训练精度的下界，并对若干标准算法实例化；3）对简单阈值学习器，所需记忆信息可多达整个数据集，尽管普通训练只保留一个边界点。

Conclusion: 普通学习过程中被丢弃的信息，可能在后续删除时变得必要。因此，为支持"仅遗忘"，模型可能需比标准训练保留更多信息。

Abstract: Machine unlearning asks for a deletion algorithm whose output is close to retraining from scratch without the selected forget examples. In this work, we study forget-only unlearning, where the deletion algorithm receives only the trained model and the examples to forget, with no retained data or extra training information. We ask whether forget-only unlearning is always possible. We first show that this depends on the learning method: different datasets can produce the same trained model but require very different outputs after the same examples are removed. Using this observation, we derive lower bounds on how accurately unlearning can match retraining and instantiate them for several standard learning algorithms. We then ask what must be true when forget-only unlearning succeeds. To this end, we derive lower bounds on what an algorithm must memorize about the training data to handle arbitrary deletion requests. For simple threshold learners, the required information can be as large as the entire dataset, even though ordinary training keeps only one boundary point. Overall, our results show that information discarded during ordinary learning may be needed later for deletion, so models designed for forget-only unlearning may need to retain more information than standard training does.

</details>


### [567] [Distilling Graph Geometry: Knowledge Gap from GNNs to MLPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10520)
*Zhewei Chen,Hao Zhu,Jiaojiao Jiang,Ahad N. Zehmakan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GNN到MLP蒸馏中忽视学生模型应保留教师图诱导几何的位置，导致稀疏图上的谱欠拟合与密集图上的谱过拟合；提出基于Ollivier-Ricci曲率的G^2MLP框架，自适应分配预测级与表示级监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GNN-to-MLP蒸馏方法仅传递节点级预测或使用基于置信度的重加权，未明确学生应在何处保留教师图诱导的几何结构，从而导致学生表示空间出现谱失败。

Method: 以能量加权的教师-学生对齐目标为动机，提出G^2MLP训练时蒸馏框架，利用Ollivier-Ricci曲率识别两类谱误差集中区域，并据此在预测级与表示级对齐之间分配监督；部署模型为标准MLP，推理时无需图访问。

Result: 在节点分类基准上持续优于无图蒸馏基线，在两种图区域均缩小教师-学生秩差，并无需架构改动即可迁移至Graph Transformer教师与链路预测任务。

Conclusion: 明确几何保留位置对GNN-to-MLP蒸馏至关重要，曲率引导的监督分配能有效缓解谱欠拟合与过拟合，同时保持无图推理的部署优势。

Abstract: GNN-to-MLP distillation aims to retain the predictive accuracy of a message-passing teacher while deploying a graph-free MLP at inference. Existing methods mainly transfer node-wise predictions or use confidence-based reweighting, but they do not specify where the student should preserve the teacher's graph-induced geometry. We show that this omission leads to two spectral failure modes in the student's representation space. On sparse graphs, the student suffers from spectral underfit, missing high-energy teacher directions concentrated near boundary regions. On dense graphs, it suffers from spectral overfit, retaining spurious directions that the teacher has collapsed through aggregation. Motivated by an energy-weighted teacher-student alignment objective, we propose Graph Geometry-aware MLP (G^2MLP), a training-time distillation framework guided by Ollivier-Ricci curvature. Curvature identifies where the two spectral errors concentrate and is used to allocate supervision between prediction-level and representation-level alignment. The deployed model remains a standard MLP and requires no graph access at inference. Across node-classification benchmarks, G^2MLP consistently improves over graph-free distillation baselines, reduces the teacher-student rank gap in both regimes, and transfers without architectural changes to Graph Transformer teachers and link prediction.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [568] [Trustworthy Domain-Specific AI for Structured Knowledge Retrieval and Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08894)
*Ryan C. Barron*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本论文提出一种可扩展架构，将非结构化领域文本转化为结构化知识以支持检索与推理，融合语料策划、语义结构化、检索与推断的可解释流水线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将非结构化、领域特定文本转化为可供检索和推理的结构化知识，并构建可信、可部署的领域AI系统。

Method: 提出Binary Bleed（降低NMF低秩搜索复杂度的二分搜索）与HNMFk（自适应深度、专家引导的层次主题建模）；构建类型化知识图谱与语义对齐向量库，通过事件驱动同步；提出T-SRAG动态路由检索，结合对比对齐与张量链接预测补全图谱。

Result: 在网络安�全、法律、材料科学与医疗领域，检索精度、早期趋势检测、假设生成与幻觉缓解均有提升。

Conclusion: 提供一个模块化、可部署的基础，用于可信的领域专用AI系统，可对结构化知识进行检索与推理。

Abstract: This dissertation presents a scalable architecture for transforming unstructured, domain-specific text into structured knowledge for retrieval and reasoning. It integrates semi-automatic corpus curation, semantic structuring, retrieval, and inference into an interpretable pipeline.
  The research introduces Binary Bleed, an adapted binary search method that reduces low-rank search complexity for Non-negative Matrix Factorization (NMF), and Hierarchical NMF with automatic latent feature selection (HNMFk), a depth-adaptive topic modeling method that produces interpretable taxonomies guided by subject matter experts. These representations populate a typed Knowledge Graph and a semantically aligned Vector Store containing extracted latent features, synchronized through an event-driven substrate.
  Tensor-Structured Retrieval-Augmented Generation (T-SRAG) dynamically routes queries across retrieval paths. Contrastive alignment maps document and query embeddings to hierarchical topic structures to improve semantic fidelity and reduce hallucinations. Beyond retrieval, tensor-based link prediction identifies and completes missing links in the Knowledge Graph, supporting inference grounded in citation structure.
  Applications across cybersecurity, law, materials science, and healthcare demonstrate improvements in retrieval precision, early trend detection, hypothesis generation, and hallucination mitigation. The dissertation provides a deployable, modular foundation for trustworthy, domain-specific AI systems that retrieve and reason over structured knowledge.

</details>


### [569] [What Transfers from a VLM Teacher? Comparing Supervision Signals for Visual Document Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09177)
*Saba Sturua,Han Xiao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 视觉文档检索器对比训练常用正样本蒸馏VLM教师，本文提出将教师用于判断挖掘出的负样本（硬负样本/分数蒸馏），ViDoRe v2 nDCG@5从55.2提升到63.0，显著优于描述对齐和注意力方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法把VLM教师用于增强正样本（注意力、描述），但标签只标注正样本、对负样本无信息，教师用于负样本判断可能有更大价值；且标签不完整导致许多相关页被当作负样本推开。

Method: 在固定学生、数据、优化器和评估条件下，让教师对检索器挖掘的候选负样本进行判断，采用教师判断的硬负样本与分数蒸馏；与从同一挖掘池选四个候选的教师无关规则（含现有正样本感知阈值方法）对比，并做人类标注审计。

Result: 教师判断的硬负样本与分数蒸馏使ViDoRe v2 nDCG@5由55.2升至62.6和63.0；描述对齐增益2.6，注意力无增益。教师判断比最佳无教师规则高4.1（v2）和1.7（v3）。标注者认为每查询前四挖掘候选中约两个相关却未被标注。教师评分粗糙：82%落在0-100尺度两端，相关/不相关二分仍保留大部分增益。十人审计显示教师处于人类标注者变异范围内，对单一确定答案查询可靠。

Conclusion: 教师信号用于负样本判断比用于正样本增强更有效，能纠正标签不完整带来的假负样本问题；教师判断与人类标注一致且达到实用可靠水平，优于无需教师的启发式规则。作者公开代码、教师判断、挖掘池、人工审计和适配器。

Abstract: Visual document retrievers are trained contrastively: each query is matched to one page labelled relevant - the positive - and pushed away from negatives, pages presumed irrelevant. Recent methods distil a vision-language model (VLM) teacher into the retriever by enriching that positive, transferring the teacher's attention over it or a description of it. We ask whether the teacher is better spent on the other side, judging the candidates the retriever mines as negatives, which the label says nothing about. With student, data, optimizer and evaluation fixed, teacher-judged hard negatives and score distillation raise ViDoRe v2 nDCG@5 from 55.2 to 62.6 and 63.0; description alignment, as adapted here, gains 2.6 points and attention grounding nothing measurable. Against teacher-free rules that select four candidates from the same mined pool at identical training compute, the best of which is the positive-aware threshold current systems use, the teacher's judgement adds 4.1 points on v2 and 1.7 on v3. This is consistent with how incomplete the labels are. Annotators judge about two of a query's four top-ranked mined candidates relevant, none of them labelled, so training pushes the retriever away from relevant pages treated as negatives. What reaches the student is coarse: under a greedily decoded 0-100 rating prompt, 82% of the teacher's ratings come back at one end of the scale or the other, and a relevant/irrelevant partition keeps most of the distillation gain. A ten-annotator audit places the teacher within the range of variation among human annotators, and finds it reliable where a query has a single determinate answer. We release the code, the teacher's 3.3M judgements and page descriptions, the mined pools, the human audit and the trained adapters at https://github.com/elastic/vdr-teacher-signals.

</details>


### [570] [Quantize by Drift: Label-Free Mixed-Precision Post-Training Quantization for Text Embedders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09227)
*Hyojung Han,Jongmin Kim,Seung-Hun Jeon*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出无需标签的“量化诱导表示漂移”作为混合精度后训练量化的敏感性信号，在检索嵌入器上验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合精度量化需要逐模块敏感性信号，但文本嵌入器最直接的指标（量化对检索质量的损害）依赖部署中稀缺的相关性标签。

Method: 用无标签替代量：量化单个模块、重编码语料，测量输出嵌入偏离全精度位置的程度；作为在一次加性分配、硬性打包字节预算、无标签无搜索下使用。

Result: 五个开发嵌入器上，配置级漂移对留出检索质量排序的宏观Spearman为0.911；跨校准语料与检索域可迁移，模块漂移可秩一致地组合但非数值组合，相关性推导的敏感性无一致增益。三个密封嵌入器上预注册方向假设相对LieQ成立（3/3）且漂移在2/3上优于双侧LieQ；但主预算下比同预算均匀精度低（-0.99、-0.85、-1.01分）。

Conclusion: 输出漂移是稳健的粗粒度敏感性信号，而非普遍最优的分配目标：可避免迁移的带符号几何适配的灾难性失败，并在均匀精度崩溃的紧张预算下仍可用，但围绕强均匀工作点的细粒度再分配仍未解决。

Abstract: Mixed-precision post-training quantization needs a per-module sensitivity signal; for a text embedder the obvious one -- the retrieval quality a module costs when quantized -- needs relevance labels that deployments rarely have. We measure a label-free substitute: quantization-induced representation drift, obtained by quantizing one module, re-encoding the corpus, and recording how far the output embeddings moved from their full-precision positions. What is specific is the observable: the deployed output representation a dense retriever ranks with. Across five development embedders, configuration-level drift orders sampled mixed-precision plans against held-out retrieval quality at a macro Spearman of 0.911, the sensitivity transports across calibration corpora and retrieval domains in the usable regime, module drifts compose rank-consistently but not numerically, and relevance-derived sensitivity adds no consistent value. The method is one additive allocation under a hard packed-byte budget, with no labels and no search. On three embedders held untouched until method, baselines and hypotheses were frozen and sealed, the pre-registered directional hypothesis against the prior LieQ criterion holds (3/3 at the main budget, no collapse) and drift scores above a two-sided LieQ steelman in 2/3; but at the main budget drift is numerically lower than same-budget uniform precision on all three (-0.99, -0.85, -1.01 points), having reduced module and whole-model drift as designed. Output drift is thus a robust coarse sensitivity signal, not a universally optimal allocation objective: it avoids the catastrophic failures of the transferred signed-geometry adaptation and can remain usable at stressed budgets where uniform collapses, but fine-grained redistribution around a strong uniform operating point remains unresolved.

</details>


### [571] [Reading Position Is the Baseline to Beat: A Time-Ordered Evaluation of Personalised Highlight Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09262)
*Kazuki Nakayashiki,Keisuke Watanabe*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文主张文档内个性化推荐应以阅读位置为基线，并在时间顺序下评估。实验显示，仅按首个高亮位置排序即可在47%情况下命中下一高亮，远超流行度(26%)与相似度方法(29%)，但相似度方法未能在既定比较中超越流行度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阅读产品最廉价的个人信号是读者在页面的首个高亮。直觉方案是推荐相似早期读者标记的内容并以流行度衡量，但作者质疑真正的基线应是阅读位置本身，且需在时间顺序下评估。

Method: 在一个社交高亮平台上进行时间顺序评估，使用7,343个读者-页面配对、覆盖1,511个页面（均含一次高亮）。对比方法包括：紧邻首个高亮下方的句子排序（不使用其他读者数据）、流行度、两种相似度方法中较优者，以及按距最新高亮距离折减的流行度（三种尺度中平均精度最佳者）。并预先设定比较，检验相似度方法相对流行度的增益。

Result: 对下一高亮目标：位置排序命中前五达47%，流行度26%，相似度较优者29%。但对所有后续高亮目标，位置排序劣于流行度；距离折减流行度在两种目标上均优于流行度与两种相似度方法。预先设定的比较中，相似度方法相对流行度在平均精度上无增益，增益+0.01被排除。合成读者实验与逆时间评估进一步说明单纯增益不能证明捕捉到读者偏好。

Conclusion: 文档内个性化应在时间顺序下、以阅读位置为基线进行评估。位置结果属探索性且未确认；相似度方法未显示相对流行度的真实增益，评估需警惕虚假的偏好发现。

Abstract: A reader's first highlights on a page are the cheapest personal signal a reading product has. The natural plan is to suggest what similar earlier readers marked, and to judge the result against popularity. We argue that the baseline to beat is reading position. In a time-ordered evaluation on one social highlighting platform (7,343 reader-page pairs on 1,511 pages after one highlight), ranking the sentences just below a reader's first highlight, with no other reader's data, puts the next highlight in the top five 47% of the time, against 26% for popularity and 29% for the better of two similarity methods. The baseline depends on the target: over all later highlights that ranking loses to popularity, while popularity discounted by distance from the latest highlight, at the scale with the best average precision of three tried, beats popularity and both similarity methods on both targets. In a comparison specified in advance, neither similarity method shows a gain over popularity in average precision over all later highlights, from one to five highlights, and a gain of +0.01 is excluded. Nor would a gain by itself show that a method has found a reader's preferences: synthetic readers who share one set of preferences produce one, and an evaluation out of time order shows a method where the reader went. The position results are exploratory and unconfirmed. Personalisation inside a document should be evaluated in time order and against reading position.

</details>


### [572] [From Chunks to Functional Evidence: Function-Aware Retrieval for EDA Documentation QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09361)
*Xiaotian Qiu,Kairui Liu,Shi Chenyi,Jinyuan Deng,Qi Sun,Cheng Zhuo*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文针对 EDA 文档中查询与知识组织方式不匹配的瓶颈，将 RAG 的检索单元从孤立 chunk/二元关系重构为“功能单元超边”，并在新数据集 EDADocEval-QA 和 ORD-MMBench 上显著提升 ROUGE-L。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂技术文档中，RAG 的主要瓶颈往往不是模型推理能力，而是查询与知识组织方式之间的不匹配。这一问题在 EDA 文档中尤为突出，因为回答所需信息分散在异构但紧密耦合的工件中。

Method: 重新设计 RAG 的基本检索单元：不再基于孤立 chunk 或二元关系，而是将带类型的工件组织为 EDA 功能单元，每个单元记录为由超边连接其源 chunk；训练编码器对齐查询与功能单元，结合单元检索与直接 chunk 检索；将选中单元映射回源后，用统一 reranker 选择给生成器的证据。

Result: 在新建 EDADocEval-QA 数据集上，ROUGE-L 比 Chunk RAG 提升 37.1%，比最强图基线提升 55.6%；在公开 ORD-MMBench 上比最强基线提升 30.0%。

Conclusion: 实验结果支持在所评估的 EDA 文档场景中采用“功能感知”的证据组织方式。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is widely used to ground answers in documents. For complex technical documentation, however, the primary bottleneck is often not model reasoning but a mismatch between a query and the way knowledge is organized for retrieval. This mismatch is pronounced in Electronic Design Automation (EDA) documentation, where the information needed for an answer is scattered across heterogeneous yet tightly coupled artifacts. We therefore redesign the basic retrieval unit of RAG. Instead of operating on isolated chunks or binary relations, we collect typed artifacts into EDA functional units. Each unit is recorded as a hyperedge with links to its source chunks. We then train an encoder to align queries with functional units and combine unit retrieval with direct chunk retrieval. After mapping the selected units back to their sources, a unified reranker chooses the evidence given to the generator. On the newly constructed EDADocEval-QA dataset, our method improves ROUGE-L by 37.1% over Chunk RAG and 55.6% over the strongest graph baseline. On the public ORD-MMBench benchmark, it improves ROUGE-L by 30.0% over the strongest baseline. These results support function-aware evidence organization in the evaluated EDA documentation settings.

</details>


### [573] [Finding the Right Balance: Relevance and Diversity in LLM Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09412)
*Guillaume Brouillette,Faustin Kagabo,Usef Faghihi,Nadia Ghazzali*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 检索多样化在RAG中的有效性取决于候选池冗余度：在干净池上有害，在多证据高冗余任务上有益；作者提出按查询自适应的多样化规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究对检索多样化能否提升RAG检索与答案质量结论不一，需要厘清其效果随条件变化的规律。

Method: 通过受控近重复注入与生产式重叠分块实验，分析多样化效果与候选池冗余、查询所需证据数的关系；提出查询自适应规则（仅当近邻top-k中有效不同文档数低于查询证据需求时才多样化），并引入RNG-Score几何重排器（带精确近邻回退，其间隔指示重复结构）。

Result: 多样化在干净池上损害相关性、证据覆盖与答案质量，但在多证据且冗余导致近邻检索重复选段时转为有益；自适应规则利用现有嵌入即可获得大部分可及收益，并跨数据集与编码器迁移，对单证据查询自动退化为近邻检索。

Conclusion: 检索多样化应基于可观测的冗余度与查询证据需求进行选择性使用。

Abstract: Retrieval diversification is widely available in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frameworks, yet prior studies disagree on whether it improves retrieval and answer quality. We show that its effectiveness varies primarily with candidate-pool redundancy, in a pattern consistent with the number of distinct evidence pieces a query requires. Using controlled near-duplicate injection and production-style overlapping chunking, we find that diversification harms relevance, evidence coverage and answer quality on clean pools, but becomes beneficial on multi-evidence tasks when redundancy causes nearest-neighbor retrieval to select repeated passages. We therefore introduce a query-adaptive rule that diversifies only when the effective number of distinct documents in the nearest-neighbor top-$k$ selection falls below the query's evidence requirement. Computed from existing embeddings, the rule captures most of the achievable gain, transfers across datasets and encoders and automatically reduces to nearest-neighbor retrieval for single-evidence queries. We also introduce RNG-Score, a geometric reranker with an exact nearest-neighbor fallback whose margin indicates duplicate structure. Overall, we conclude that diversification should be used selectively, based on observable redundancy and evidence requirements.

</details>


### [574] [Towards Explaining Query Expansion Performance in Information Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09724)
*Sourav Saha,Aditya Dutta,Soumajit Pramanik,Mandar Mitra*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文从"理想扩展查询(IEQ)"和"可分离性"两个视角解释查询扩展(QE)性能差异，提出近似IEQ及可分离性度量，并在TREC多个数据集验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: QE长期用于缓解检索中的词汇不匹配问题，在LLM检索系统中仍具相关性，但没有任何单一QE方法在所有查询上一致占优，其性能差异成因缺乏解释。

Method: 提出两个互补视角：一是理想扩展查询(IEQ)，即便BM25检索效果最大化的假设查询；二是可分离性视角，用Cohen's d量化给定扩展查询下相关与非相关文档得分的区分度。开发可分离性度量及近似IEQ的实际公式并分析其与检索效果的关系。

Result: 在TREC Robust、TREC DL 2019-2022段落集合及TREC DL 2019-2020文档集合上实验发现：越接近理想扩展查询的扩展查询通常检索效果越好；相关与非相关文档的可分离性提供了理解QE性能的互补视角。

Conclusion: IEQ接近度与可分离性可共同解释QE性能差异，为理解和改进QE方法提供了新的理论与实证依据。

Abstract: Query Expansion (QE) techniques have long been widely used in Information Retrieval (IR) to address the vocabulary mismatch problem. They remain relevant in modern retrieval systems, including those based on large language models (LLMs). However, no single QE method consistently outperforms others across all queries. This work seeks to explain the variation in QE performance through two complementary perspectives. The first is the concept of an Ideal Expanded Query (IEQ)--a hypothetical query that maximizes retrieval effectiveness with a downstream BM25 retrieval model. The second is a separability perspective, which quantifies how distinctly relevant and non-relevant documents are scored for a given expanded query using Cohen's (d). We develop a separability measure and practical formulations to approximate the IEQ and investigate how these factors relate to retrieval effectiveness. Extensive experiments on the TREC Robust collection, TREC DL 2019-2022 passage collections, and TREC DL 2019-2020 document collections reveal several interesting patterns. In particular, we find that expanded queries that are closer to the ideal expanded query tend to achieve higher retrieval effectiveness. We further show that the separability of relevant and non-relevant documents provides a complementary perspective for understanding QE performance.

</details>


### [575] [The Impact of Backbone Evolution on LLM-Based Relevance Assessments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09820)
*Chuting Yu,Guido Zuccon,Teerapong Leelanupab*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文挑战"更强LLM会带来更好相关性判断"的假设，发现模型升级并不保证更优或更稳定的判断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM快速迭代，通常认为在相同提示下，能力更强的新模型会与人类判断更一致。作者对此提出质疑。

Method: 固定提示，评估单提示（UMBRELA）和基于评分细则（EXAM）两种提示，在商业模型（Gemini、GPT）和开源模型（Qwen、Llama）的连续版本上测试LLM相关性判断表现。

Result: 无一致证据表明新版本带来更好的相关性判断；聚合性能相似或提升并不意味着判断稳定，早期版本的正确判断不一定被后续版本保留。作者进一步分析了这些退化的潜在原因。

Conclusion: 不应假设为某一模型版本设计并验证的评判提示在同一家族模型更新后仍等效或更优。

Abstract: LLMs are evolving rapidly, with newer models offering stronger capabilities. This suggests that in LLM-based relevance judging, more capable models will achieve higher agreement with human judgements under the same prompt. We challenge this understanding by investigating the behavior of LLM-based relevance judges under backbone evolution. Keeping the prompts fixed, we evaluate a representative single-prompt (UMBRELA) and a rubric-based prompt (EXAM) across sequential model versions of commercial (Gemini, GPT) and open-weight (Qwen, Llama) models. Overall, we find no consistent evidence that newer versions lead to better relevance judges. Crucially, similar or improved aggregate performance does not imply judgment stability: correct judgements made by an earlier version of an LLM backbone are not necessarily preserved by later versions. We investigate the potential drivers of these regressions. Our findings caution against the assumption that judging prompts designed and validated for one backbone version will perform equivalently or better when the model is updated, even within the same family.

</details>


### [576] [Inverting Multi-Vector Visual Document Indices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09920)
*Zhuchenyang Liu,Yao Zhang,Yu Xiao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 多向量视觉文档检索器的索引可被反演还原原文页面，敏感信息易泄露，token pooling与shuffling是低成本防护手段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多向量检索器将每页存为约千个patch向量于第三方向量库，因向量不可读而被误认为不如原页敏感，作者假设运行或侵入该库者可仅凭索引还原页面。

Method: 将反演建模为条件文档图像生成，从向量推断所需的编码器、页面形状及（对打乱向量）其顺序，并在ViDoRe v3上验证，同时用token pooling和shuffling两种防护及顺序恢复模型进行测试。

Result: 原始索引反演页面恢复47%单词与45%敏感token，作查询时98.4%将源页排第一；pooling与shuffling将词召回降至约8%，顺序恢复模型使排序第一比例从3.8%升至93.5%，而反演pooled索引仍未被攻破；另一检索器上攻击页面仍70.2%排第一，词召回低于最近邻基线。

Conclusion: 多向量视觉文档检索器通过其存储索引存在反演脆弱性，索引应像其编码的文档一样受到保护。

Abstract: Prevailing multi-vector visual document retrievers store each page as about a thousand patch vectors, often in vector databases run by a third party. Since no one can read a page from its vectors, this index is easily treated as less sensitive than the page. However, because the index keeps one vector per patch in raster order, and each vector is computed by a vision-language model pre-trained to read documents, we hypothesize that whoever runs or breaches the store can reproduce a page from its index alone. We frame inversion as conditional document image generation and infer from the vectors what the attack needs: the encoder, the page shape and, for shuffled vectors, their order. On the ViDoRe v3 benchmark, pages inverted from raw indices recover 47% of the words and 45% of the sensitive tokens. Used as queries against the stored indices, they rank their source page first 98.4% of the time. We test two cheap protections, token pooling and shuffling, which both cut word recall to about 8%. A model that restores the order of a shuffled index raises the share of source pages ranked first from 3.8% to 93.5%, while inverting a pooled index remains open. To test generalisation, we apply the same attack unchanged to another multi-vector retriever: its inverted pages still rank their source page first 70.2% of the time, though its word recall stays below a nearest-neighbour baseline. Multi-vector visual document retrievers are therefore vulnerable to inversion through their stored index, which should be protected like the documents it encodes.

</details>


### [577] [Training with Missed Targets in Generative Recommendation: Separating Supervision from Probability Competition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10124)
*Xuesi Wang,Yangbin Shi,Xiaolin Zheng*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文分析了生成式推荐中将生成器遗漏目标追加到重排训练列表的策略，发现追加目标与推断候选之间的概率竞争可能损害返回项排序，并提出匹配损失进行解耦实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式推荐器返回的候选集有限，可能在重排前遗漏观测目标。常见训练策略将这些遗漏目标追加到重排训练列表中，但推断时仍只对原始候选排序。该操作同时改变检索目标权重、引入追加目标监督，并使两组目标竞争概率，因此简单的“追加/不追加”对比无法解释返回项排序变化。

Method: 构建三种匹配损失，固定检索目标权重，分别引入追加目标监督和组间竞争。其中中间损失在两组内训练但分别归一化，防止仅训练时出现的追加目标与推断候选竞争。

Result: 在已发布的OneRec模型和本地训练的Amazon生成器上实验表明，这种竞争可能损害返回项排序。在四个预设的Amazon Video Games比较中，去除竞争使FT-NDCG提升7.8%–22.2%；用户层面的95%区间以及四个训练运行区间中的三个不包含零。保守开发集规则在一个留出类别中为三个生成器中的两个选择追加目标训练，在另一类别中拒绝全部三个，避免了1.7%的损失。

Conclusion: 候选补全应根据每个生成器分别评估，而不应自动应用。

Abstract: Generative recommenders return a limited candidate set and may omit observed targets before reranking. A training strategy appends these missed targets to reranker training lists, although inference still ranks only original candidates. This operation simultaneously changes retrieved-target weight, adds supervision over appended targets, and makes the two groups compete for probability. An append/no-append comparison therefore cannot explain changes in returned-item rankings. We construct three matched losses that hold retrieved-target weight fixed while introducing appended-target supervision and group competition separately. The intermediate loss trains within both groups but normalizes them separately, preventing training-only targets from competing with inference candidates. Experiments with a released OneRec model and locally trained Amazon generators show that this competition can harm returned-item ranking. In four prespecified Amazon Video Games comparisons, removing it improved full-target normalized discounted cumulative gain (FT-NDCG) by 7.8--22.2\%; 95\% intervals over users and three of four intervals over training runs excluded zero. A conservative development-set rule selected appended-target training for two of three generators in one held-out category and rejected it for all three in another, avoiding a 1.7\% loss. Candidate completion should therefore be evaluated for each generator rather than applied automatically.

</details>


### [578] [Does Document Structure Help Dense Retrieval? A Placebo-Controlled Ablation of Four Mechanisms Across Two Corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10170)
*Andrey Kuehlkamp,Priscila Correa Saboia Moreira,Samuel Rund*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文通过机制隔离的消融实验，在统一协议下测试四种文档结构处理（结构对齐分块、LLM生成上下文、标题路径元数据、两阶段层次检索），发现组织结构有效源于内容而非token，并用安慰剂对照验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献分别支持四种文档结构处理，但基于不同语料、嵌入器和指标，且未控制共同混淆因素：任何前置到块的文本都会扰动其嵌入。

Method: 机制隔离消融，统一协议；跨条件匹配块大小；加入语义空安慰剂（结构有效但跨文档打乱的标题路径）；覆盖率感知nDCG评分；4个预注册对比，文档聚类bootstrap+Holm校正；两个语料：200篇Wikipedia Featured Articles（951查询）和1585篇QASPER论文（4303问题）。

Result: 结构对齐分块+真实标题路径优于上下文固定窗口（+0.022/+0.012 cov-nDCG@10）及安慰剂（+0.010/+0.016）；朴素两阶段层次检索有害（-0.033/-0.015），归因于第一阶段section recall；Wikipedia上金标结构优于LLM诱导结构，QASPER上无差异；效应量小（dz 0.06-0.11）但Holm显著且跨语料一致。

Conclusion: 组织结构确实有益，原因是内容而非token；标题路径具有真实语义价值；朴素层次检索有害；金标结构并非普遍优于LLM结构；效应虽小但稳健。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation systems increasingly rely on document-structure treatments: structure-aligned chunking, LLM-generated chunk contexts, heading-path metadata, and hierarchical two-stage retrieval. Separate studies support each on different corpora, embedders, and metrics, and none control for a shared confound: any text prepended to a chunk perturbs its embedding. We present a mechanism-isolating ablation testing all four treatments under one protocol, matching chunk sizes across conditions and adding a semantically null placebo---heading paths that are structurally valid but shuffled across documents. We score retrieval with a coverage-aware nDCG and test four pre-registered contrasts via document-clustered bootstrap with Holm correction, on two distant corpora: 200 Wikipedia Featured Articles (951 queries) and 1,585 QASPER papers (4,303 questions). Organization helps, and the cause is content, not tokens: structure-aligned chunks with real heading paths beat contextualized fixed windows (+0.022 / +0.012 cov-nDCG@10) and the placebo (+0.010 / +0.016). Naive two-stage hierarchical retrieval hurts (-0.033 / -0.015), traceable to first-stage section recall. Gold structure beats LLM-induced structure on Wikipedia but not on QASPER. Effects are small ($dz$ 0.06-0.11) but Holm-significant and consistent across corpora.

</details>

# cs.MM [[Back]](#toc)

### [579] [MemoCare: An Interactive Multimodal Mobile System for Automated Cognitive Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10448)
*Duy-Cat Can,Mau Minh Phuc Le,Tuan-Khoa Hoang,Hai-Dang Nguyen,Trung-Hieu Do,Dang Minh Ly,Minh-Duc Nguyen,Nghia TT Hoang,Linh-Trung Nguyen,Huy-Hieu Pham,Huong Ha,Binh T. Nguyen,Oliver Y. Chén*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: MemoCare是一个交互式移动端多模态认知筛查系统，结合语音、时空定向、触屏操作与视空间建构，支持英语和越南语。系统通过确定性NLP规则、GPS解析、交互事件评分及三模型CNN共识完成自动评分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 认知筛查通常依赖人工施测与评分，成本高且难以标准化。作者希望用移动端多模态交互实现自动化、跨语言的认知筛查流程。

Method: 采用React Native构建应用，整合Google语音转文本、任务特定确定性NLP规则、GPS空间模块、触屏事件评分，以及三模型CNN共识的绘图评分（选中ShuffleNetV2 x1.5）。

Result: 软件测试151/151通过，空间回归48/48通过；绘图模块在71张锁定测试集上平均平衡准确率91.33%、三标准精确准确率78.87%；四位临床医生评估八项标准中位评分4/5（各项3–4.5）。

Conclusion: MemoCare展示了多模态移动认知筛查的可行性，具备良好测试表现与临床初步认可，并将在MMM提供简化流程现场体验。

Abstract: MemoCare is an interactive mobile system for automated multimodal cognitive screening. A React Native application combines spoken responses, temporal and spatial orientation, touchscreen actions, and visuoconstruction in complete English and Vietnamese workflows. Speech is transcribed by Google Speech-to-Text and scored locally with deterministic task-specific natural language processing rules; GPS coordinates are resolved by the MemoCare spatial module before answer matching; touch tasks are scored from interaction events; and the drawing task uses a three-model convolutional neural network consensus with separate visual interpretation. Software tests pass 151/151 predefined cases across speech/language, spatial-answer, and touch-interaction scoring, while spatial regression passes 48/48 four-country coordinate-resolution cases. For the drawing module, validation-selected ShuffleNetV2 x1.5 achieved 91.33% mean balanced accuracy and 78.87% exact three-criterion accuracy on a locked 71-image test set. Four clinician co-authors additionally inspected the end-to-end workflow, yielding a pooled median rating of 4/5 across eight criteria, with item-level medians ranging from 3 to 4.5. At MMM, attendees can directly try a shortened multimodal screening workflow and inspect automatic item-level and total scoring.

</details>
